notes.title: Full Release Update | Patch #5 | V1.1.8166.35967
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/287ec6e27c58ddaa585eb5c73a7e825a84efc96a.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings survivors,[/b]
We've just released the fifth Patch for our full release version of Endzone. Once again, we focused on fixing bugs, tweaking stuff and improve your overall experience with the game. Please keep reporting bugs, giving us your valuable feedback and posting your great suggestions whether to Discord or the Steam discussions!

[b]Important Notes[/b]
[i]We have recognized that many of you are not satisfied with the raider system. We are not able to completely overhaul it but we made several changes that should make the experience feel less random and unpredictable.  [/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/8e51c1f1958dc0c928f359be2519868b560cdb6f.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] Fixed issue with "Back to the Endzone" scenario which falsely allowed prosperity content before being completed, which resulted in errors.
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] The first voice-over of the "Future without sunlight" scenario is now correctly played in English language.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/859cfcb2e4578eb319334272a605a80e0499490b.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Added breadcrumb navigation at the top of the screen. This UI should help understand which part of the expedition you're currently in.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed a bug that could cause too many food resources to be deducted.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Advantages and badges are now correctly reset when leaving the configuration screen of an expedition.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Resources delivered to an Expeditions Post are now correctly updated in the building inspector, when an expedition was started and all explorers are gathered at the Expedition Post.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Dialogue points that don't consume rations no longer check how many rations are left. Also, the continue button now hides the confidence bar if no rations are required.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Several fixes to wrongly displayed camera positions.
[*][b]Environment:[/b] Fixed faulty tree rendering. Trees should now flicker significantly less.
[*][b]Environment:[/b] Fixed occasional stuttering in tree falling-animation.
[*][b]Camera:[/b] Small fixed to camera movement and target following behavior.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed several graphical glitches for several buildings.
[*][b]System:[/b] The game's ram usage has been optimized. It should now use considerably less memory.
[*][b]UI:[/b] The efficiency UI of a building now updates to its correct percentage value when switching through buildings that are or are not boosted by a factory unit.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Fixed multiple raider warnings that could appear after loading.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Switch through building buttons in the build menu are now correctly disabled for buildings that can only be placed once.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed several links to wrong pages of the glossary.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Militia is now manning up towers right after the settlement received word that a raider attack is upcoming. This way, it's safe to say that your towers will be manned up when the attack starts.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Workers are now also filling up towers with ammunition. They do so during peace and even during an attack. If workers have a task to stock up ammunition, they won't be intimidated by raiders.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Towers can now hold up to 250 units of ammunition instead of 100. Savegames are automatically upgraded to the new amount.
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] Increased ammunition amount the player needs to produce in "Hunter and Hunted" scenario.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Improved layout of administration window to avoid overlapping of build menu button with scrollbar button.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Adjusted layout for benefactors in local expedition selection.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Cancel button for expeditions is now grayed out if the expedition is already on its way home.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] The Expedition window now considers Expedition Rations that were left at a ruin, before showing a warning prompt, if there is only a small amount of rations available.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Decorations are now sorted under their own headline.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Several fixes to the fade to black effect and cursor behavior.
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] Scenarios are now sorted by file name in the menu selection.
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] Scenarios now indicate the DLC they belong to, which is highlighted by a ribbon.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Several small improvements to the expedition selection screen.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Electricity can no longer be deactivated on self-sufficient buildings.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Buildings that become self-sufficient electricity producers when being upgraded now automatically turn their electricity back on.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Entering the expedition window no longer clears the corresponding notifications.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Holding Shift while adjusting certain numbers now allows larger steps (e.g. for number of professionals in the profession menu).

notes.title: New Trailer available: Endzone - Survivor Edition for Current-Gen Consoles
notes.content:

Today, we have released a brand-new trailer to celebrate the May 19 arrival of survival city-builder Endzone - A World Apart: Survivor Edition on current-gen consoles. 

[b]Set for launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, Endzone - A World Apart: Survivor Edition includes the base game and the first DLC chapter titled “Prosperity.”[/b]

[previewyoutube=VS62s6JC6Yk;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]“While it’s been a long-time desire for us to bring Endzone to consoles, the UI overhaul required to adapt such a deeply immense strategy game is nothing short of a challenge,”[/i] said Stephan Wirth, Co-Founder and Experience Lead, [i][b]Gentlymad Studios[/b][/i]. [i]“We’re so excited to share this lovingly created game with new audiences come May, and we sincerely hope players enjoy the experience we’ve crafted for consoles.”[/i]

[*] [b]Can’t We Order In?:[/b] To get fresh supplies and learn new information, scouting parties must engage in Expeditions — which involves leaving the safety of the colony and   venturing out into the dangerous wasteland to scavenge valuable resources

notes.title: “Distant Places” launches on May 17, 2022 | New screenshots!
notes.content:
The time is now, and a new horizon awaits! 
We are happy to reveal today a [b]May 17, 2022, Steam launch date for “Distant Places”[/b] — the all-new DLC coming to our survival city-builder [b]Endzone - A World Apart[/b]. 
The [b]Distant Places DLC[/b] brings [i][b]new story missions, new buildings for settlement expansion, exotic and fruity new food items, and most importantly, a means for aerial travel.[/b][/i]

Along with the release date announcement, we have revealed a batch of never-before-seen screenshots showcasing new environments awaiting you, the players. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/8925f974df8e847b7a8afd34a13e67fb38d55db8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/aaf7b10bd9346f16bbb1c6ef52226498963ef125.jpg[/img]

In Distant Places, you can explore exotic, bountiful lands beyond the safety of your settlement's borders. Life in your settlement finally began to flourish in the preceding DLC, Prosperity, and now your survivors are ready to set off on an air-balloon journey to discover the “distant places” their legends speak of.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ad46238be2018b97d8798986e9c88d7b4c9cfc40.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/8262f25ba1c8d2d7c000335748741253c66b5c88.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4254e4f09177336a5c24e63a45e6fa201dedbd71.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9974ff02872113ebcf1036824ddd44f80f8e8185.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/24bec41ad7e88779857b3ddedb3246871c71f5ca.jpg[/img]


[h3]About Distant Places DLC[/h3]
[b]Distant Places[/b] centuries after settlers managed to regain a foothold on the surface of Earth after having been in subterranean bunkers for over 150 years to escape a radioactive hellscape on the ground above. Featuring 12 narrative-driven expeditions, settlers of the “endzone” will fly to four unknown destinations far beyond their usual borders in search of other displaced survivors, new food items, and brand-new building blueprints, perfect for expanding settlements into (primitive) metropolises.

[h3]Features of Endzone’s “Distant Places” DLC [/h3]
[list][*] [b]A Story Untold:[/b] Experience 12 story-driven, large-scaled global expeditions that take you to four varied, yet unseen places of the world. Suited for only the most well-equipped adventurers, they offer uncertain but very rewarding outcomes.
[*] [b]Brick by Brick:[/b] Support and expand the settlement with new buildings by discovering blueprints during treacherous new expeditions.
[*] [b]Beyond the Mysterious Beyond:[/b] Driven by an insatiable quest for knowledge and resources, settlers can take to the skies aboard their purpose-built hot air balloon in search of new opportunities.
[*] [b]Exotic Seeds!:[/b] Give the gift of scurvy prevention, by letting settlers experience the unique tastes and merits of six all-new exotic seeds like coconuts and bananas.[/list]

[h2]Endzone - A World Apart’s Distant Places DLC will be available via Steam on May 17, 2022![/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1883650/Endzone__A_World_Apart_Distant_Places/


[h3]Earth Appreciation![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/b2700f8f0532c6e4895ce9e2a8f00255970b927a.jpg[/img]
The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/AppreciateEarth]Earth Appreciation Festival[/url] on Steam has started, and we are part of it!
Starting right now, for the duration of Steam's Earth Appreciation Festival, when you buy a Standard- or Save The World Edition of our survival citybuilders [b]Endzone – A World Apart[/b], or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273220/Sphere__Flying_Cities/][b]Sphere – Flying Cities[/b][/url], we will save the world slightly more together.

notes.title: Distant Places News #2 - Meet Lem, the Tinkerer!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/bc60ba5533c21f719170471324ea7f1dc0d26571.png[/img]

[h3]You are traveling in your balloon to a location that is not noted on the old maps. A radio message drew our attention to this area. As you travel over the flooded lands, a small hill rises out of the water in the distance.[/h3]

[b]Eli:[/b] [i]"I can't believe it, but there seems to be someone living on that mountain in the middle of the water."[/i]
[b]Levi:[/b] [i]"I doubt it. Just look how run down it is. This place is absolutely abandoned, isn't it? Places that aren't on the maps, we find everywhere by now, and we never run into anyone."[/i]
Jamie starts laughing.
[b]Jamie:[/b] [i]"Yeah yeah, that is usually the case, but Eli is right this time. I could just make out a figure at the window through the telescope. A quick look won't hurt."[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/575f580d5eb21633af90053b58e095caf17584bf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/7c3affc603ba6afbeebed5ed930aa2c5c6f4a422.png[/img]

Lem is affectionate, chaotic and curious. He distrusts strangers, but is not afraid of new acquaintances. He is a lonely genius with a big affinity. Living on this island has certainly not done his mind any good over the years, but what he wants in life is quite clear… or is it?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[h3]If you want to know more about Lem and his breathtaking machines, get ready for the [b]Distant Places DLC[/b]. You'll accompany the crazy tinkerer and help him complete a wondrous machine. Of course, he will reward you for your help![/h3]

notes.title: Endzone celebrates first year anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/25370dd4710420d781949d1dad225ca4ebcc7551.png[/img]
[b]Survivors,[/b]
We are really grateful to have so many passionate veteran survivors among us, while also welcoming new players each day! Only because of you, Endzone has not just grown out of Early Access successfully, but thanks to your ongoing dedication, feedback and ideas, we were even able to go beyond our initial vision. All this really means a lot to us, and with this post and the first anniversary of our full release, we also want to say a heartfelt “Thank You”! Without your support, this would not have been possible, and we are humbled to have such a loving community.

To celebrate, we made a little recap of some of our achievements and the road we travelled together, including some dev bloopers and pictures from the team.

Additionally, even while our Early Access has ended, we are glad to be able to extend what Endzone has to offer with our ‘Prosperity’ expansion and the soon-to-be-released DLC ‘[b]Distant Places[/b]’. Not to mention the upcoming release to consoles in May!

[h2]The developer’s Journey – Recap of our ride![/h2]

As part of our one year Endzone full release anniversary, we would like to give you some behind the scenes impressions with a focus on our daily work situation, interesting happenings like fairs and award shows and last, but not least, development bloopers.

[/list]

[b]Where we at? Bloopers, yes.[/b]

Join our Discord and have a look at more funny Behind the Screens stuff: [i][url=https://discord.com/invite/worldofendzone]https://discord.com/invite/worldofendzone[/url][/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[h3]Next Stop: Endzone is heading to consoles and the upcoming Distant Places DLC; both scheduled for a May 2022 release! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/aa022e63e67619f9f8612264494812c8f28a363a.jpg[/img]

“[i]While it’s been a long-time desire for us to bring Endzone to console platforms, the UI overhaul required to adapt such a deeply immense strategy game is nothing short of a challenge,[/i]” said Stephan Wirth, Co-Founder and Experience Lead, Gentlymad Studios. “[i]We’re so excited to share this lovingly created game with new audiences come May, and we sincerely hope players enjoy the experience we’ve crafted for consoles.[/i]”

Coming to Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5, Endzone - A World Apart: Survivor Edition includes the base game and the expansion “[b]Prosperity[/b].”
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[h3]Distant Places DLC heading to Steam[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/40729ad92cfde53320feca3e8fceaed02b749188.png[/img]

It has been centuries since we started to regain our foothold on the surface of the earth. 

Up to this day, we have strived to establish a flourishing haven, much more than just a shelter to withstand the harsh environment we find ourselves in. 
It’s a place that provides safety, health care, education and even electricity, but most importantly, it’s a place everybody can call their home. 

A place to pursue happiness. But even after reaching these important milestones and creating a new and healthy civilization, our people are still curious as to what lies ahead.

Being the pioneers they are, they want to reach out to other survivors and discover new and exciting places beyond the borders of the settlement. They want to uncover the Distant Places, far, far away, that so many legends speak of.

Additionally, recently, we have released the first fresh new details from the headquarters, also showcasing some new exotic seeds you can expect and for sure some screenshots for the upcoming Distant Places DLC, with our Devlog: https://steamcommunity.com/games/933820/announcements/detail/3129443759936554752

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[h3]You want more?[/h3]
Stay tuned and follow our official channels, especially here on Steam. 
As be assured, we are planning some more Devlogs, providing you with more details and insights for our upcoming DLC until its release in May 2022!

Additionally, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/worldofendzone][b]official Endzone Discord server[/b][/url]. There, you have the chance to talk with all those other survivors and veterans that have been here since we first announced Endzone - providing a warm welcome for all those new players, too!

Further on, we at Gentlymad Studios are also around, and even though busy providing you with more awesome content for our Endzone – A World Apart, also always curious about your feedback and thoughts.

notes.title: Endzone Survivor Edition Announced for Current-Gen Consoles; Coming May 2022
notes.content:
Together with developer [i][b]Gentlymad Studios[/b][/i], we are delighted to announce that our post-apocalyptic city builder [b]Endzone - A World Apart will receive a current-generation console launch on May 19, 2022, titled, Endzone - A World Apart: Survivor Edition.[/b]

Coming to Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5, Endzone - A World Apart: Survivor Edition includes the base game and the expansion “Prosperity.” 

[i]“While it’s been a long-time desire for us to bring Endzone to console platforms, the UI overhaul required to adapt such a deeply immense strategy game is nothing short of a challenge,”[/i] said Stephan Wirth, Co-Founder and Experience Lead, Gentlymad Studios. [i]“We’re so excited to share this lovingly created game with new audiences come May, and we sincerely hope players enjoy the experience we’ve crafted for consoles.”[/i]

[h3]Watch the Endzone - A World Apart: Survivor Edition announcement trailer:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=pSAFWoLPZN0;full][/previewyoutube]

The console version, Survivor Edition, will introduce players to the world of Endzone, where they’ll be responsible for the last remaining settlement of humans who’ve emerged to the Earth’s surface following 150 years in underground bunkers to escape global destruction via nuclear holocaust. 

[b]Endzone - A World Apart: Survivor Edition launches digitally on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S on May 19, 2022![/b]

[h3]More about Endzone - A World Apart: Survivor Edition:[/h3]
Steeped in a world tainted by radiation poisoning following a worldwide nuclear disaster, Endzone - A World Apart: Survivor Edition tasks players with a monumental responsibility: build a civilization and maintain the wellbeing of Earth’s last remaining human colony. Players will use the tools at their disposal to build housing structures, develop a functioning electrical system, and maintain stable water and food supplies — just a few of the valuable resources required to support a thriving society. Unlike similar titles in the genre, Endzone won’t see players face off against ghastly ghouls and irradiated monstrosities. Instead, violent weather events, such as sandstorms and drought, as well as tribes of brutal raiders, are the violent forces that seek to destroy the settlement.

[h3]Features Include: [/h3]
[list][*] A Bustling Community: The settlement is rarely quiet or dull; fulfill over 90 side missions, all of which are rich in variety and cater to the various needs of your community’s inhabitants
[*] Build, Expand, Survive: With more than 90 different buildings to construct and maintain, including power stations, shelters, water treatment plants, and, unfortunately, cemeteries, colony-architects have a vast selection of structures from which to create a flourishing community
[*] Can’t We Order In?: To get fresh supplies and learn new information, scouting parties must engage in Expeditions — which involves leaving the safety of the colony and venturing out into the dangerous wasteland to scavenge valuable resources
[*] Dynamic Radiation Simulator: Keep those iodine pills handy, as Endzone features realistic radiation and humidity values that force players to take into account important details about the soil in which they grow their crops.[/list]

[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Factory Unit now only shows resources missing if none requested resources are available.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed that the beacon was not properly disconnecting from the power grid when the grid is overloaded while powering it on.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed field of influence bonus of irrigation plant not resetting when starting a new game from a running session.
[*][b]Demands:[/b] The demand in “More than survival” which requires the player to provide soap now also asks the player to provide stew, in order to be aligned with what is written in the text.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]

[*][b]Resources:[/b] Settlers now gain happiness & health when consuming soap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/859cfcb2e4578eb319334272a605a80e0499490b.gif[/img]

[list]

[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixing a minor inconvenience with the resource selection overlay on pastures.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Kitchen now only shows missing resources when resources are actually missing. Additionally, it also highlights missing water separately.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Deconstructing roofed fields no longer leads to an invisible rectangle unaffected by rain.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Prioritising the repair of a building now only leads to Builders being assigned there first and no longer the workers of the building.
[*][b]System:[/b] Mystic shadows that appeared above lakes were banished.
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] Followup missions for "More Than Survival" now only triggers if you have exactly 0 Greenhouses/Aquafarms.
[*][b]System:[/b] Planning Mode is now correctly resetting after starting a new game.
[*][b]Research:[/b] Starting a new session now correctly resets the techtree.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed tooltips, being able to go outside the screen bounds.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Expedition Post now shows the correct occupant list, so you can see what your settlers are doing.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Expedition Post now displays production progress for expedition rations.
[*][b]Missions:[/b] "Dead Bodies on Our Streets" mission should no longer trigger if the player has the "Immunity" decree active, since failing the quest triggers an illness.
[*][b]System:[/b] STOMTs now upload a recent save game, if available, when sending feedback.
[*][b]System:[/b] Fixed resetting the game speed to default instead of previous speed, when the STOMT dialogue window is opened.
[*][b]Terrain:[/b] Removed empty lakes from terrain that prevented placement of buildings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]

[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Clicking on a Guard Tower with missing resources warning no longer clears the missing-flag. The disappearing after a click was confusing.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Enabled shadows for several buildings that were missing shadows (Guard Tower, Barricades, Siren Tower and more).
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Buildings that can only be placed once will show their tooltip again, but don't show the needed resources, instead of hiding the tooltip completely.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Settlers are now taking less processing power when trying to get resources that are currently not available. This should fix the extreme lag in savegames with large settlements.
[*][b]System:[/b] Switched back to the "Mono scripting" backend for better unofficial mod support.

notes.title: Endzone – A World Apart: Halloween. A free DLC with The Great Old One, and more!
notes.content:
Survivors!

Today marks the release of our [b]free[/b] all new Halloween DLC for Endzone - A World Apart! It introduces [b]14 additional decorative items[/b], giving you the option to bring [b]a darker theme to your settlement[/b] - as well as a little something your settlers can eagerly worship!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/6a2e0013afa82599c89e302efadd4835bd928096.gif[/img]

[h3]Important Information:[/h3]
This DLC is available indefinitely, not just during Halloween Season! So if you forgot to check in during Halloween, don’t worry! The content will still be there to enjoy.

Additionally, the new decorative items don’t just look spookily great, but are also tied to Endzone’s game mechanics for decorative items and increase your settlement’s attractiveness (looks like your settlers really like eerie stuff, huh…)

If you are not a fan of Halloween, all DLC content can also be disabled manually by deselecting the DLC in your Steam options.

[h3]New additions:[/h3]
[b]Will the Great Old One bring salvation to the post-apocalyptic world of Endzone?[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/d328a37565cfb46bf276aa3ef1e81079713d392d.png[/img]

Well, this is something way above our understanding. However, your settlers are now able to build a statue of the “The Great Old One” to worship this cosmic deity in all its glory! Of course, we wanted to keep it real: It must be placed in the water, close to the shore of your settlement!
Once the construction is completed, you’ll see your settlers eventually start worshiping at the altar - which is in their own best interest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/72e57c3f1217ee916b3bd3d42c56479d6e060088.gif[/img]

As a side note, if you got your hands on the recently released [b]Prosperity[/b] expansion, the new Pumping Station can free up some of your workforce, so your people should have enough spare time to pray to the Great Old One, so at least he won’t end this world once and for all!

[h3]Yet, there’s much more to discover:[/h3]
We not just added a statue of the Great Old One, but 13 additional themed decorations on top. These decorations have an impact on your settlement’s attractiveness, just like regular decorations. It’s a win-win situation: Fantastic new decorations that actually help you, making your settlers happy (weirdly enough) by increasing attractiveness in their vicinity!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4a1e0a1a0a9146e97a8c6befe436874ad7c269ad.png[/img]

[h3]Among many others you can find:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/c88fe6ae096cfa1fd1d507819a2c43244a553d10.png[/img]
[b]Pumpkins[/b] – [i]Total cliché; no Halloween without pumpkins![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/aa852c9b6a51a11fdb83281efcc6649f6f16ebd1.png[/img]
[b]The Grim Reaper?[/b] - [i]It’s dark times we’re in, it can’t get worse, can it?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/1d7024676fb610f26a1ef1007ecb0d8459f9390f.png[/img]
[b]Scarecrow[/b] – [i]To keep the fields safe from ravaging birds...and cheeky kids? Safe bet.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/5e3c562692d76339c6ca69f988b34e111fae41b3.png[/img]
[b]Hanging Cage?[/b] – [i]A reminder that even though the world almost ended, there are rules to follow. Punishment is to be expected when stepping out of line.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/db59aed93324f392c8203cf4e3aec220f8c8c181.png[/img]
[b]Gargoyle?[/b] – [i]Definitely! Scary looking, but actually a guardian of your settlement. – Well not literally guarding your settlement, as raiders could still sneak past them, but hey...Gargoyles are cool![/i]

And [b]SO MUCH MORE[/b] decorations, giving you the great opportunity to change the overall appearance of your settlement! Great fit for Halloween Season and beyond.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/c8d04c730f903f29dc2bec0cddbffbbeb65282e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/b3b0785f9291a1f77888371805c26be6da2a152c.png[/img]

The free Halloween DLC will automatically be activated if you own Endzone - A World Apart. We hope that it brightens not just your settlers' day, but yours as well. Thank you for your ongoing support!

notes.title: All-New “Prosperity” Expansion for Endzone - A World Apart Now Available!
notes.content:
Today, we, both teams of [i][b]Assemble Entertainment[/b][/i] and [i][b]Gentlymad Studios[/b][/i], are thrilled to announce the launch of [b]Endzone - A World Apart: Prosperity[/b], now available here on Steam. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632320/Endzone__A_World_Apart_Prosperity/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/927b60a1a9a294ab5ed9667b728b057ba39a42bc.gif[/img][/url]

The release is paired with a fresh trailer showcasing the expansion's new features, as well as some of the luxuries in which the survivors can now partake. 
[b]Prosperity[/b] isn’t just a title —  after carving out a home in this ruined world, surviving through toxic rain, sandstorms, and even attacks from their fellow man, settlers can finally enjoy some of the finer things in life...like soap!

With over 350,000 units sold on Steam and GOG and 4,000 positive Steam reviews, we are proud to release this highly anticipated expansion. 
With new freedoms come new challenges, as players now not only have to tend to a resident’s needs but also their wants. The new generation isn’t simply content with surviving, but instead, thriving. Adding to the game’s realism, this expansion will have players strategize in different and demanding ways, planning out community decisions with more than just survival in mind. Citizens will want their Town Center upgraded into a proper City Hall and ultimately, the residents will eventually request the construction of a long-lasting building as a shining example of all the progression and accomplishments: [b]The Beacon[/b].
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632320/Endzone__A_World_Apart_Prosperity/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/c9740c3c4a5a27ee3570cbe5be3ce87d40767dac.gif[/img][/url]

[h3]Prosperous Times[/h3]
With the [b]Prosperity[/b] expansion bringing fresh luxuries like beer, cake, coffee, and soap, players might forget that the previous threats haven’t just disappeared. Along with the comfort items, the expansion also brings new resources like sand, concrete, metal, and cement for upgraded building construction. Utilize the new supplies to protect the community from the still present threats of toxic rain, violent sandstorms, savage raiders, and the ever-looming threat of radiation. Though, once the settlement has been fortified, they’ll be free to put up their feet with a nice cup of coffee — they’ve earned it.

[b]Additionally, to celebrate the launch of the Prosperity expansion, you can get 10% off launch discount on Prosperity and, if you do not own Endzone - A World Apart yet, get 34% on both Standard and the Save The World Edition on Endzone - A World Apart![/b]

[list][*] [u][b]Live Your Best Life:[/b][/u] With growth and security comes luxury, and hot new items like beer, cake, coffee, and thankfully, soap are now available for survivors to enjoy!

notes.title: Endzone – A World Apart: Prosperity News – Rise and Shine
notes.content:
[b]Survivors![/b]

Right before the release of [b]Endzone - A World Apart: Prosperity[/b], we are back with another look at some new features of our upcoming expansion. This time we’ll take a closer look at some new buildings and how they can make your life easier, while also freeing your settlers from some burdens of manual labour.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/927b60a1a9a294ab5ed9667b728b057ba39a42bc.gif[/img]

[h1]New Buildings – Aspiring a new Level Of Comfort[/h1]

[h2]Pump it up and stash it![/h2]

Water Towers are a great way to store large amounts of water and to prepare for droughts. Additionally, by using different water sources, like the Electric Well, you can also diversify how and when you stock up more water. Still, at least one task always remains: [b]Assigning the many, many Water Carriers to store the precious resource by hand[/b]. This is tedious for your brave little worker bees and for you as their leader, especially when planning and sustaining larger settlements. To better this situation, meet the new: [b]“Pumping Station”[/b] and the [b]“Upgraded Water Tower”[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/628df6b404ff65e55b7cbd93aad0e2124e76c354.gif[/img]
[i]Many Water Carriers proudly fulfilling their duty.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/0b6caaf6c2609702079ea59d8ae90b5bdab0692a.jpg[/img]
[i]A new and efficient way of getting those tanks filled up.[/i]

Upgrading to the new Water Tower is useful, as it can store [b]4 times as much water[/b], which alone helps in having to build less of them. Additionally, the new building can work in conjunction with the [b]“Pumping Station”[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/68c88cc4ee85de2ef199591def4a933590106612.gif[/img]
[i]The Pumping Station in action. [/i]

The [b]“Pumping Station”[/b] needs to be built at a nearby lake and be connected to a power grid. With these requirements satisfied and while in the vicinity of an [b]Upgraded Water Tower[/b], it can [b]pump water into the water storage of the tower automatically[/b].

With this you can drastically [b]reduce the workforce needed for Water Carriers[/b], while also giving you a valid alternative besides the Electric Well as a new comfortable means of preparing for the next drought.

Keep in mind: This new and powerful building needs to be earned by researching through the new Prosperity research tree, gathering new resources and extending your electricity network to support the new building. Remember, everything comes at a cost!

[h2]Good Tools are half the Work![/h2]

We listened to your feedback concerning the production of new tools and protective clothing. Even the Upgraded Workshop or Tailor buildings sometimes can’t do the job in time, especially in bigger settlements and later stages of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/87392aa2ae275bddda4214e4b4cf6651ad74e790.jpg[/img]
[i]The typical setup in larger settlements to keep up with production needs.[/i]

Instead of having to upgrade to even more efficient buildings, we chose to introduce the [b]“Factory Unit”[/b]. This building [b]uses the new and advanced resources[/b] to help and [b]boost production buildings in its vicinity[/b] and make them more efficient. Think of it as a special research facility where specialized equipment is produced to help the surrounding production buildings in ramping up their production.
As long as new resources are available, and you have engineers assigned to work in it, all buildings in the Factory Unit radius will receive the bonus. The buildings that benefit from its effect are: The Tailor, Workshop, Medical Facility, Armory and the Decontamination Post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/2c1bb1126dfce158dc4d4ccd4909778872277c60.jpg[/img]
[i]The Factory Unit at work, please be quiet, our engineers are thinking...[/i]

As with most of the new buildings, getting there and advancing to the point where you can research and use this new building is part of the journey and the challenge. So with this, take care and keep surviving!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

Like last time, this is just another glimpse at some features of the “Prosperity” expansion, which will be released on [b]October 21st[/b]. [i]Additionally, stay tuned for a little free DLC that is just around the corner…[/i]

Once again, thank you for all the great support and immense feedback we are receiving since Early Access and Full Release of Endzone! Please keep it up, and stay tuned for more!

notes.title: Full Release Update - Patch #3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/03af55bda6b92068336c12b02f959008de5f58c8.gif[/img]

Greetings, survivors!

The third regular patch for the release version of Endzone - A World Apart focuses on bringing once again various bug fixes, tweaks and quality of life improvements to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a2234f76715900e6ab8ba7f9f0ad4f4e5e26d067.gif[/img]
[list][*] [b]Feedback:[/b] The feedback tool (F1) now tries to upload a current savegame, so we can investigate issues and bugs better.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list][*] [b]System:[/b] Added ability for the game to handle additional content for the “Prosperity” expansion and a free DLC that is just around the corner but shh…
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Added a dynamic news system to keep you up-to-date with current events and happenings.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Added “Pack Full” option to expeditions to automatically fill up the expedition inventory with excavated resources and items.
[*] [b]Achievements:[/b] Added 3 new achievements concerning settlement population.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list][*] [b]Localizations:[/b] Several localizations fixes in several languages.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed a bug concerning the Decontamination Post.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Pastures now stop production when the production limit for food is reached.
[*] [b]Options:[/b] Fixed an error related to On-Demand Rendering.
[*] [b]Statistics:[/b] Droughts that last for multiple years are now correctly recognized by statistics.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed a bug that was related to wrongfully missing repair resources for damaged buildings.
[*] [b]Camera:[/b] Fixed a bug with the camera, where the wrong values were used when zooming out.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Fixed several wrong links to the glossary.
[*] [b]Options:[/b] Fixed an error caused by the options menu.
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] The settler UI no longer shows settler drawbacks when the settler is in fact dead.
[*] [b]Research:[/b] Techpoints and research equipment amount are now reset when starting a new game.
[*] [b]Environment:[/b] Fixed bug where the ground humidity would use radiation as its base value.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Ingame UI is no longer hidden when opening the platform overlays while in the main menu.
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] Newly created moving settlers can now be selected right at the start of a new session.
[*] [b]Savegame:[/b] Invalid savegames now hide their play button icon.
[*] [b]Savegame:[/b] Invalid or incompatible save games no longer show the "Load Game" tooltip on play button.
[*] [b]Statistics:[/b] Fixed technology count in the game statistics screen.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed error related to efficiency boosts.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed flickering of "Missing Resources" UI for the pub.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Fixed error with wrong settler avatars being displayed in settler dialogs.
[*] [b]Statistics:[/b] Placeholder of search field in the game statistics is now translated.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Fixed line-breaking of texts in the goal window.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed flickering of "No seed selected" for fields.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Buildings that require electricity to work no longer display the efficiency UI.
[*] [b]Trading:[/b] Fixed trader not leaving when demolishing trading post.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Edge scrolling now only works while the HUD is open.
[*] [b]System:[/b] Opening and closing any backend overlay will no longer reset the games speed to default but will set to the last set speed instead.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Fixed wrong avatar being shown during a settler dialog under certain circumstances
[*] [b]Game:[/b] Fixed a bug where world animations would stutter or stop completely for different environmental effects (e.g. rain, trees or building animations).
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Game Progress for unlocked buildings now only counts buildings that are actually placeable by the player.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Settler Dialogs now only show a close button if the mission is a mission from the bulletin board that is not yet solved.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list][*] [b]Research:[/b] Completely overhauled the research UI for better usability and overview. Technologies are now organized in different tabs and are now organized from left to right.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] The inventory screen (Loot and return) of expeditions has been overhauled for better usability. It is now easier and faster to fill up the inventory with different resources by using sliders.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] The workplace radius of all related buildings can now be changed while the building is still in construction.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Inventory Limits can now be adjusted while the building is still in construction.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] The water source UI now also displays the count of all valid sources inside the workplace radius.
[*] [b]Sound:[/b] Added sound effect to placing a drag/drop world task (e.g. upgrade buildings/demolish buildings etc.).
[*] [b]UI:[/b] “Mailto:” Links now open in the correct mail app.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] After visiting a building, settlers will no longer walk to a random position around their current location, but will walk to a random position around the building's entry.
[*] [b]Environment:[/b] The game now creates resource piles in the world if the internal storage of the production building is full.
[*] [b]Savegame:[/b] Overhauled asset loading when starting the game to be less stressful on your system.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Tweaked a “ruin city”, so that the diner ruin is never occluded by trees and always visible.
[*] [b]Savegame:[/b] Recipes unlocked by technologies now unlock corresponding technologies when loading a savegame.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Building buttons now hide their tooltip when they were already built and are only placeable once.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] “A Light for the Night” side mission is now only put on the bulletin board, when the player has wind generators or solar collectors already researched, making it more realistic to complete the mission.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Recipe selection has been improved, so that recipe selection and production are done at the same spot.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Scroll sensitivity of all text fields have been reduced, to avoid unwanted behavior.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] The goals window of the HUD now has Tabs when playing in scenarios, so that side missions and scenario goals are categorized and allow for a clear focus.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] All houses and shelters received a visual overhaul so they can be distinguished better and don’t contribute too much to the “visual noise”.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Improved tooltips with more information and overall better structure and presentation.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Changed the efficiency UI of every related building to be more clear and descriptive. It now displays if electricity boosts the building or not.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Changed the “overpopulation” side mission so it is less misleading (hopefully), and doesn’t require you to simply “wait”.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Changed the behavior of technology missions on the forum. These missions were previously filling up the available missions slots, preventing some other missions from ever appearing. This has now been reduced to max. one technology mission at a time, giving more space for all other missions to appear.
[*] [b]System:[/b] Several Performance boosts and internal system overhauls to go lighter on CPU and GPU usage to avoid overheating issues. 
[*] [b]Session Settings:[/b] Removed the “Legacy” option for research in the settings of a new session.
[*] [b]Trading:[/b] Adjusted trade values of hemp, iodine-tablets and expedition rations
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Greatly reduced the amount of herbal huts and medical facilities needed for the “Sick Survivors” Side Mission.
[*] [b]Builders:[/b] Improved logic for profession “builder” for repairing buildings.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/db129d941f7d67ddee9462723769d76f517552f9.gif[/img]
[list][*] [b]Localizations: [/b]
Some languages didn’t receive their proofread versions for a small number of UI texts yet. This will be improved in a future patch.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[i]- Your Team from Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment[/i]

notes.title: Endzone - A World Apart: Prosperity News – Dawn of a new Era
notes.content:
[b]Survivors![/b]
Some time has passed since we shared the last details about our upcoming Prosperity expansion. Now is the time to give you the first in-depth look into some of the new features and gameplay aspects.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632320/Endzone__A_World_Apart_Prosperity/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/927b60a1a9a294ab5ed9667b728b057ba39a42bc.gif[/img][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[h3]Demands – Yearning for Prosperity[/h3]
Most of the new content and features of Prosperity are blended in with the natural overall progression in the game. To get access to the new content you have to build a stable settlement and progress through the technology tree. After researching enough technologies your settlers will become more demanding, reaching for more comfort in their lives. 
To communicate their new demands and to usher in this new era in your settlement, your people will ask to upgrade the trusty Town Center to become a [b]City Hall[/b]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eb14bb5cc54c3408b065c3ba7598f218f8db3619.jpg[/img]
[i]The City Hall[/i]

After doing so, a new research tab will open up, giving you access to researching the many new buildings and automatisms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/c6266d96341a98cecaba1e65227bf8c8ef60d039.jpg[/img]
[i]New tech-tree of the Prosperity expansion[/i]

At the same time, your settlers will start issuing their new needs and demands. 
Listen closely and abide by their demands to keep them happy. Ignoring them might lead to revolts and even migration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/caf64dc602c3f737d7d193bd96025bc95de5ca15.png[/img]
[i]Your settlers' new demands. For example: the new luxury good coffee[/i]

In this case, your people want the luxury of steaming hot coffee. Who would be mad enough to not grant them this wish? Let’s get our researchers to figure out how we can produce this delicious beverage...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/084480e7137cd44b4b9e8a641b36334d4b90b3f4.jpg[/img]
[i]Coffee tech-tree[/i]

We also need to find the coffee plant seed and cultivate it in a field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a04f4bce886db66c2bd69f0ebeb625355093530f.gif[/img]
[i]Another addition to the huge variety of crops and fields for prosperous farming enthusiasts:
The Coffee Field[/i]

[b]Finally, we can produce the coffee in one of our pubs.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/8a1b004ecc347b86b8ebaa9ce0309cbf5bc8a528.png[/img]
[i]Pub UI for Coffee[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/abf518b2d864e28aebe0817a85a300e961f3a7ca.jpg[/img]
[i]Did we mention? - Pubs can now be upgraded![/i]

After fulfilling this demand our people will enjoy their coffee and become “hopeful” buying us some time until issuing another demand.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/08e5b0454afc710396e1ac1e5b1d189f6b2a96f5.png[/img]
[i]Happiness UI: Hopeful State[/i]

[h3]The Beacon - A Shining example of Success[/h3]
With prosperous times come new responsibilities, and so your settlers will eventually ask you to expand and grow your settlement. After all, a new and lasting civilization won’t be built from stagnation. Together with this commitment comes the request to construct a long and lasting building as a shining example of all your progression and accomplishments: [b]The Beacon[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/c9740c3c4a5a27ee3570cbe5be3ce87d40767dac.gif[/img]
[i]The new Beacon in all its mighty pride[/i]

Constructing this building is a massive undertaking and will require several steps, from planning, constructing the base until reaching its final and impressive form. Getting there will be part of the journey, as this task will require many, many resources and manpower to complete.
As a reward, the landmark does not only look breathtaking, but will also be increasing the attractiveness of your whole settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/5524db964cc389f63ebdb2fc0afb752178dae15a.gif[/img]
[i]Construction step 1 of The Beacon[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ec950ff017f296b2618c0b7eff85da7e8fae1e57.gif[/img]
[i]Construction step 2 of The Beacon[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/5420b51a71871c99c600db8be3bf8da0d1d7cb48.gif[/img]
[i]Construction step 3 and final step of The Beacon[/i]


A lot more is awaiting you, yet we won’t spoil everything new in advance, and keep some room for surprises until the full Prosperity release at the end of this month.
What do you think so far? Feel free to provide us your feedback across our official channels.

Lastly, thank you for all the great support and immense feedback we are receiving since Early Access and Full Release back in March! Keep it up, and stay tuned for more news until the Prosperity Release on October 21!

notes.title: Endzone - A World Apart: Prosperity Addon Gets Release Date - October 21, 2021!
notes.content:
Live long and prosper—ity, survivors! 

Today, we are happy to announce that our Endzone - A World Apart Prosperity addon will be released on October 21, 2021! 
Not only that, but we’ve dropped a brand-new gameplay trailer showing off the soon-to-come features. 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632320/Endzone__A_World_Apart_Prosperity/]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/5c5b7f715381367f4e74bcf882bf3e7bf3ab976c.png[/img][/url]
[h3]About the Prosperity Addon:[/h3]
The Prosperity addon will take the plucky post-apocalyptic wasteland dwellers from struggle-mode to alive‘n’thrivin’ with new materials, buildings, challenges, and new adventures! While their predecessors worked hard to eke out a meager existence in a world that wanted them dead, this new generation finally has a chance to actually enjoy life — whether that means a nice soapy bath or a cold ale.

After a successful launch on Steam and GOG with more than 350,000 units sold and 3,800 positive Steam reviews, we have been hard at work crafting a new addon that brings some refreshed hope and positivity to the world of Endzone. Residents of the colony can now make demands of the player, providing even more depth and realism to the experience and adding new layers to the strategy. It’s not just about building a functioning colony, the needs and requests of this new generation have gone beyond simply finding a safe place to sleep and food to eat.

Of course, toxic rain, violent sandstorms, savage raiders, and the ever-present threat of radiation aren’t just going away, but the colonists deserve some time to kick back and enjoy the good things in life. The Prosperity addon brings fresh luxuries like soap, beer, cake, and coffee, along with new resources like sand, concrete, metal, and cement for enhanced constructions and a whole set of new buildings!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632320/Endzone__A_World_Apart_Prosperity/

[h3]Watch the new Prosperity gameplay trailer here:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=4EnpeGTAX9Y;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3]Features of the Prosperity Addon:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Live Your Best Life:[/b] With growth and security comes luxury, and hot new items like beer, cake, coffee, and thankfully, soap are now available for survivors to enjoy!
[*] [b]Built to Last:[/b] New construction materials like sand, concrete, metal, and cement will ensure your buildings can withstand the toughest environmental challenges while providing a more sophisticated dwelling.
[*] [b]Expand Your Industries:[/b] New materials and more spare time means growing the colony’s production capabilities with all new buildings, including sand mines, aqua farms, and concrete factories.
[*] [b]New Adventures:[/b] The Prosperity addon will introduce three brand-new scenarios that will test the limits of the next generation of survivors.[/list]

[h3]About Endzone - A World Apart:[/h3]
Endzone - A World Apart is a city-builder-meets-survival-sim that puts players in charge of growing and maintaining a colony beset by toxic rain, sandstorms, radiation, and roving gangs of violent raiders. Build farms, water plants, schools, and everything else a burgeoning society requires to not only survive but thrive in a world that’s not exactly fit for human occupancy!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/933820/Endzone__A_World_Apart/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f6535bf35155402120176bc84c86fffd142a727f.png[/img][/url]
Staying with the environmental themes of Endzone - A World Apart, Assemble Entertainment has teamed up with the charitable organization [url=https://onetreeplanted.org/]One Tree Planted[/url] to plant a tree for every Save the World Edition bundle purchase. Not only that, players that buy the Save the World bundle will also receive a free copy of the game’s stellar soundtrack!

notes.title: Endzone - A World Apart - New “Prosperity” Expansion Coming This Fall!
notes.content:
Survivors!
We are pleased to announce that our major expansion to our post-apocalyptic city builder, Endzone - A World Apart, the “Prosperity” expansion will launch in fall 2021 and will bring a host of awesome new features, upgrades, and additions. 

After a successful launch on Steam and GOG with more than 250,000 units sold and a smashing 3,500 positive Steam reviews, we have been hard at work behind the scenes building the new expansion and can’t wait for players to jump in this all to experience all the new content!

[h3]About Endzone - A World Apart: Properity[/h3]
After 150 years underground and hidden away from the poisonous surface, the last remaining human survivors of a nuclear apocalypse emerged, ready and willing to take back the planet. 
Of course, starting from scratch isn’t a walk in the park, and the remnants of humanity faced many challenges attempting to reboot society — toxic rain, violent sandstorms, and the ever-present threat of radiation, to name but a few. 
However, thanks to the grit and determination of the human spirit, things are finally looking up for the survivors, and after the struggle comes boundless “Prosperity”! The upcoming Prosperity expansion will introduce new materials, new buildings, new challenges, and new adventures to a fresh group of survivors, ready to expand and improve on what their forebears proudly built. 

[h3]Watch the new Prosperity trailer here:[/h3]
[previewyoutube=63lWXCjj4fM;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=63lWXCjj4fM[/previewyoutube]

[h3]Wishlist the Prosperity Addon on Steam now:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632320/Endzone__A_World_Apart_Prosperity/

[h3]Features of the Prosperity Expansion:[/h3]
[list][*] Live Your Best Life: With growth and security comes luxury, and hot new items like beer, cake, coffee, and thankfully, soap are now available for survivors to enjoy!
[*] Built to Last: New construction materials like sand, concrete, metal, and cement will ensure your buildings can withstand the toughest environmental challenges
[*] Expand Your Industries: New materials and more spare time means growing the colony’s production capabilities with all new buildings, including sand huts, aqua farms, and concrete factories
[*] New Adventures: The Prosperity update will introduce three brand-new scenarios that will test the limits of the next generation of survivors[/list]

[h3]Brand-new screenshots of the Prosperity Expansion:[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632320/Endzone__A_World_Apart_Prosperity/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/041cbe667248813980f65ed65cbd748a139f0a13.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1632320/Endzone__A_World_Apart_Prosperity/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/c9e28d2a16df87025fd4c72ceac9291eb3b7bbfd.jpg[/img][/url]


[h3]About Endzone - A World Apart[/h3]
Endzone - A World Apart is a city-builder-meets-survival-sim that puts players in charge of growing and maintaining a colony beset by toxic rain, sandstorms, radiation, and roving gangs of violent raiders. Build farms, water plants, schools, and everything else a burgeoning society requires to not only survive but thrive in a world that has had more than enough!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/933820/Endzone__A_World_Apart/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f6535bf35155402120176bc84c86fffd142a727f.png[/img][/url]
Staying with the environmental themes of Endzone - A World Apart, Assemble Entertainment has teamed up with the charitable organization One Tree Planted to plant a tree for every Save the World Edition bundle purchase. Not only that, players that buy the Save the World bundle will also receive a free copy of the game’s stellar soundtrack!

notes.title: Full Release Update | Hotfix #4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/03af55bda6b92068336c12b02f959008de5f58c8.gif[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]
Due to numerous reports of death waves that occurred when building a shelter early in the game, [b]we decided to let aged settlers move out of houses automatically[/b] to give younger settlers the chance to replace them and start a family. This prevents aged settlers from blocking houses until their death which led to younger settlers moving into houses too late to have children before they reach old age themselves, resulting in sudden extinction of large parts of the population, especially early in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Temporary storeroom, warehouse, and upgraded warehouse can now accept medicine, in order to store medicine that was acquired by trading or expeditions. Medicine that was produced in medical facilities will stay there unless transported to a market.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] The Town Center now accepts hearty meals, stew and cake in their inventory.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] The expeditions UI no longer indicates that collectibles can be found in a fully explored location, if the corresponding collectible has already been unlocked through research.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Fully explored ruins no longer show their progress to have a consistent look with ruins that didn't have a story.
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] The last quest of the Garden Eden scenario now asks the player to provide a home for all settlers.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed several cases where builders would idle instead of following repair or construction tasks.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Fixed some wrong Loca connections in side missions.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Missions that require buildings of a specific category being connected to a power grid now check all respective buildings correctly.
[*][b]UI:[/b] The red highlight that indicates invalid placement positions while in build mode no longer glitches when trying to place a building outside the left or bottom map border.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed skipping of several affected settlers when toggling through them using the red drawback icons at the bottom of the screen.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed some values in age distribution statistics not showing their correct values in early seasons.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Small stability fixes to prevent exceptions.
[*][b]UI:[/b] It's no longer possible to go into the main menu from a resource payment that was requested from a mission (e.g. raiders) by pressing ESC:
[*][b]UI:[/b] Autosave can no longer be triggered while the player is in the resource payment window.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Tweaked the order of decisions at the Cake Shop to make them less linear.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] The group leader of an expedition is no longer random to ensure that he always receives and therefore visually represents tools or radiation protection that are found during an expedition.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] All advantages due to a certain profession are now advantages due to settler badges, to make them more fail-safe when assembling an expedition.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] In the electric overload side mission the player no longer needs to build recyclers, he instead has to employ more refiners (making it possible to solve the mission with a refinery).
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Rescaled the trigger condition for the side mission "We're Getting Older and Older".
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ec24c6b5efe3d99ce3ed2c8ca69509be7727a983.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Under certain conditions, that we can’t yet reproduce, settlers sometimes don’t repair buildings, we are investigating this issue.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[i]- Your Team from Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment[/i]

[i]Changelog Version [b]1.0.7822.27168[/b][/i]

notes.title: Full Release Update | Patch #2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/03af55bda6b92068336c12b02f959008de5f58c8.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]
The second regular patch for the release version of [b]Endzone - A World Apart[/b] focuses on bringing various bug fixes, tweaks and quality of life improvements to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added new fullscreen UI to adjust inventory limits for the market, to give better control over the stored resources.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Irrigation plants, watch towers, siren towers, barricades, fields and orchards now show the work areas of other buildings while they are being placed.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Added a world task for militia to prioritize guard towers.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] When repelling a raider attack (in a lethal or non-lethal way), you'll now receive loot from their bodies and stuff they threw away while fleeing. This way, repelling a raider attack results in more positive feedback. Every raider tribe yields specific loot.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Added an UI indicator to the minimap, to show where raiders will appear. This happens approx. 3 seasons before they appear, so you have time to react and prepare.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Added a settler dialogue and a notification to warn about an upcoming raider attack.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Added a side mission that references the population growth of your settlement.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Added an UI element at the top middle of the screen to show the current growth of your settlement. The indicator is based on all fertile couples that have a home.
[*][b]World Tasks:[/b] Added 6 new tasks to the building menu that allow you to perform specific actions for a selection of buildings. Supported actions are upgrading buildings, pausing buildings and dismantling buildings.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed blocking of inventories for production buildings, especially in cases where a lot of buildings needed to be repaired, where resources were reserved.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed wrong 'no/missing resources' UI for the market.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed resources being carried to the market that were disabled.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Attractiveness for buildings is now calculated correctly.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed wrong radiation level being displayed on fields and orchards.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed that fields and orchards in some cases were not being replanted, even though all cells have been harvested.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Pubs now collect beer, joints and hard liquor from crates.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Settlers now use different end positions when visiting the pioneer statue instead of just one.
[*][b]Camera:[/b] Camera can no longer be zoomed when the cursor is outside of the main screen.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Explorers no longer lose their equipment when traveling to an already explored ruin.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Advantages due to the age of settlers on an expedition now request and output the correct ages in all cases.
[*][b]Options:[/b] Fixed a bug that prevented the correct resolution to be applied correctly. For example: If you have a 4k monitor but choose to run the game in full HD, it could happen that, after restarting, the game would run in 4k again.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Fixed an edge-case where a raider mob could not move due to single raiders being stuck on the map.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Raiders now also damage buildings that are being demolished.
[*][b]Research:[/b] The game time is now always paused when opening the technology window.
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] Solved a bug in the "Garden Eden" scenario where settlers who are on an expedition aren't counted as having their home supplied with electricity.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed a bug where settlers of certain professions wouldn't die of old age for a long time, as they were too busy fulfilling their tasks.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Catastrophe missions no longer damage unfinished buildings.
[*][b]Statistics:[/b] Fixed a bug where numbers of total stored resources didn’t match with numbers displayed in the rest of the game.
[*][b]System:[/b] The timer during dialogues (e.g. when interacting with raiders) is now serialized, and can no longer be reset by saving and loading.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Traders now also offer animals when the player has none in the settlement.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Wellkeepers no longer have a water container stuck in their arm while sitting on the bike at work.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] The market now highlights all buildings in its work area where resources can be collected from.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Damaged buildings in the analytic view for building condition are now displayed in several different shades (indicating their damage level).
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Production buildings with full inventory now continue production if resources in their inventory are already reserved for transportation.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] The production amount of medicine per medical facility has been decreased.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Overhauled the inventory limits menu on storage buildings to improve the usability.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Reduced the collection rate of herbs.
[*][b]Options:[/b] Added a refresh rate warning dialogue and auto adjustments when the game is running on high refresh rate monitors.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Changed the way the first initial raider spawn happens. Instead of simply spawning at a fixed season, a side mission will help you to undertake the required steps and prepare for raiders until they actually trigger.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] The frequency of raider attacks now dynamically adjusts based on the loot they were able to obtain. If they are very successful, they will take more time until the next attack. When there was not much loot to obtain, they will try again sooner.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Destroyed buildings are now repaired faster, since they will be partially repaired to bring them back to a working state.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Side Missions that cause damage to buildings (e.g. accidents at production buildings) now cause damage immediately and not after the player has closed the dialogue.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Improved the visual feedback when a traded resource exceeds the stored amount in the settlement.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Improved all UI connected to providing information about electricity consumption, production or storage.
[*][b]UI:[/b] The electricity button in the UI of buildings now gives feedback during blackouts in the electricity grid the building is connected to.
[*][b]UI:[/b] The areas of influence for irrigation plants, guard towers and siren towers are now rendered while placing.
[*][b]UI:[/b] General fixes for line-breaks, colors and paddings in the UI.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[i]- Your Team from Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment[/i]

notes.title: Full Release Update | Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/03af55bda6b92068336c12b02f959008de5f58c8.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]
The first regular patch for the release version of [b]Endzone - A World Apart[/b] focuses on bringing various bug fixes, tweaks and quality of life improvements to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Options:[/b] Added an option to enable/disable camera edge scrolling.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Added difficulty levels for raiders when starting a new game. Raider difficulty can now be adjusted to 'Off', 'Easy', 'Normal' or 'Hard' modes. This is also reflected in game presets, if you start an "Easy game" for example, Raider difficulty level will be set to easy automatically.
[*][b]Statistics:[/b] Added a "'Stored in Well' entry for water storage.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Added a point-navigation to the game modes overview when starting a new session in the main menu.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Achievements:[/b] Fixed achievements where resources only needed to be produced, but only resources in storage were counted (stew, cake, contamination kits).
[*][b]Achievements:[/b] Fixed the "Industrialist" achievement, which requested over 200 production buildings instead of the predicted 40 to unlock.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] When cutting down an orchard, the amount of received wood is not based on the last harvest anymore. Instead, it now only depends on whether a tree is fully grown or not.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed a bug that resulted in max inhabitants being wrongfully reset when loading a savegame for Watch Towers, Schools and Graveyards.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed issue with the upgraded town center that could lead to wrong collision or placement.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Building efficiencies are now only affected by finished buildings in radius.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed issue that caused buildings to be buildable over existing power poles.
[*][b]Diseases:[/b] Diseases no longer spread while the game is paused.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Scouts can no longer be sent to a ruin ahead of the tutorial progress.
[*][b]Localization:[/b] Several fixes of wrong spelling or typos in different languages. Additionally, some "corrupted" expedition texts in Chinese were fixed.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Fixed an error that could lead to raiders being stuck.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Fixed militia behaviour for better ammo fetching during an active raider attack.
[*][b]Raiders:[/b] Fixed a bug where raiders would no longer trigger.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Several fixes to erroneous settler behavior.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed visuals of settlers with radiation suits, which were sometimes oversaturated/wrongly colorized.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Fixed an error that could result in too many buildings getting damaged during a "catastrophe" mission.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Paying resources of type food now removes the correct amount. (Traders)
[*][b]Statistics:[/b] Ruins that are fully explored and fully looted now count correctly towards the expedition game progress in the statistics.
[*][b]Statistics:[/b] Fixed resources of type food being added twice to production statistics.
[*][b]Streets:[/b] Building roads while being in the diagonal road mode now shows the correct number of cells.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Hitting reset in custom survival game settings now resets the settings to the correct preset.
[*][b]Wildlife:[/b] Fixed error with wildlife spawns and distribution.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] The cost to repair buildings has been reduced from 80% to 60% to make repairing buildings cheaper in general.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Added a new detection method to the camera during expeditions that uses rotation in order to better focus all dialog options.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Ruins that offer only resources are now one time only and don't reset and are not reusable anymore, as reusable expedition sites caused a lot of confusion and are not that practical.
[*][b]Highlights:[/b] Improved the overall hover highlight behaviour, when hovering over objects in the world. The behavior now uses an outline instead of an x-ray-effect.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Added ammunition and sulfur to resources that can be traded.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Improved feedback and skipping behaviour in settler dialogues.
[*][b]UI:[/b] The edge panning cursor is now only displayed when edge scrolling is active in the options.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Game time is no longer paused when loading a savegame.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[i]- Your Team from Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment[/i]

notes.title: Full Release Update | Hotfix #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/03af55bda6b92068336c12b02f959008de5f58c8.gif[/img]

[h2]Important note: [/h2]

[b]With this hotfix we are addressing some issues that have been reported to us on a frequent basis and should also help the current state of the raiders. Additionally, we continue on fixing issues and listening to your feedback, especially in regard to the raider feature. We try to respond to every thread and are always happy to help. Please don't be surprised if not all known issues have been fixed with this hotfix, we are still aware of them.[/b]

[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed a bug where some ground cells are highlighted as blocking even though they aren’t while trying to place new buildings in areas where buildings have been dismantled. This fix only works for newly placed buildings after this Hotfix.
