notes.title: Endzone - A World Apart | Full Release Update - Available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/03af55bda6b92068336c12b02f959008de5f58c8.gif[/img]


[h3]12 major updates, 20 patches, 100 new features & missions. One year, 350 fixes, 5000 hours of playtesting, demolished desks, buried plants, unending home office, coffee on tap an a dev accidently locked in to the office – and yet we are alive and breathing![/h3]

[b]Endzone flourished due to your dedication. Some reached season 10.000 and beyond by building massive settlements. You, the community sticked to the game, patiently followed it's development and kept on playing. You brought the world of Endzone to life by reaching over 3.5 million hours of playtime and together we have planted more than 40.000 trees.

By releasing this update we are leaving Early Access. And yet, at your request, survival has become more exciting than ever. Raiders are roaming the lands looking for rich and easy prey. Are you willing to pay and keep the peace – or are you going to fight them off with guns and bullets?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Raiders[/b]: Added raiders to the game. They consist of 5 different tribes, and start spawning in the mid game, around season 30. Every raider tribe has its own leader and motivation. You can fight off raider encounters by building defensive countermeasures. Alternatively, you can also pay tribute, which will increase every time. If you choose to fight, a raging mob spawns on the map, demolishing buildings and stealing resources from your settlement. Every mob has its health and morale. Reducing health can be achieved by firing with lethal ammunition. Less health means that the raider mob has less power. Lowering morale can be achieved by firing rubber bullets or using Siren Towers. This doesn’t weaken the effectiveness of the mob until it has lost its morale, at which point raiders will start to flee.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added the Watchtower as a defensive measure against raiders. Assign Militia to the tower to stock it up with ammunition and to fight back in case of a raider attack.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added the Siren Tower as a defensive measure against raiders. Provide the siren tower with electricity to fight back autonomously against raiders.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added Barricades with 5 different variations as a defensive measure against raiders. Barricades slow down raider movement.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added the Ammunition Factory as part of the defensive measures against raiders. It can produce two different types of ammunition. Rubber bullets and lethal ammunition. Rubber bullets reduce raiders’ morale. Lethal ammunition reduces their health.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added ability to build diagonal roads using a shortcut.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added a smoke effect for damaged buildings.
[*] [b]Research:[/b] Added 3 new technologies to the tech tree: Defensive measures, the Siren Tower and barricades.
[*] [b]Resources:[/b] Added Sulfur as a new resource that can be produced in the mine. Sulfur is used for creating bullets.
[*] [b]Options:[/b] Added FPS limiter as a graphic option. If you are experiencing heat issues you might want to enable vsync or set a FPS limitation to 30, 48 or 60 fps. Default is 60.
[*] [b]Options:[/b] Added ability to completely activate/deactivate the radiation effect.
[*] [b]Statistics:[/b] Added a game progress screen where you can track and see several key achievements of your ongoing session.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Added a building condition analytic view to see the state of all the buildings in your settlement.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Added planning mode. This mode allows you to place buildings as paused construction sites, to plan ahead with no resources being allocated. The mode can be activated via shortcut or by clicking on the planning mode icon when placing a building.
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] Added the possibility for diseases to break out, when many dead bodies are lying around; also added a new "plague" notification.
[*] [b]Sound:[/b] added voice overs in English and German for all scenarios, traders, raider encounters, tutorials and expedition introductions.
[*] [b]Sound:[/b] Added 2 new soundtrack files for raider encounters and one new gameplay track.
[*] [b]Scenarios:[/b] Added a new Scenario: Hunters and the Hunted.
[*] [b]Achievements:[/b] Added 25 new achievements to the game.
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Added a map preview for the survival game mode.
[*] [b]Map Generation:[/b] Added over 585 new map variations for the starting area, to make each map more unique.
[*] [b]Decrees:[/b] Added a new Outlander decree, and reorganized outlander missions.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Added 2 new outlander side missions and 3 new research missions.
[*] [b]World Task:[/b] Added a task to upgrade all streets in a selected area.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9fdf5ee8eebe5e1faabad35c77a4086deb80c626.gif[/img]
[i]New Map Preview
[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial:[/b] Fixed bug that prevented the completion of the Trade Tutorial
[*] [b]Tutorial:[/b] In the expedition tutorial, when sending the expedition to the gas station, Arthur now talks to the player, as the text suggests.
[*] [b]Localization:[/b] Fixed a lot of voice over to text mismatches.
[*] [b]Map Generation:[/b] Fixed error when generating small maps.
[*] [b]Map Generation:[/b] Distance to water is now always correctly calculated.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed an error when destroying the medical center.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed hunter shooting animals outside of it’s area of influence.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed Research Station not being able to handle food correctly.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed animals that were moving while they should be killed/caught.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed bug where the hunting lodge complained about missing animals, while animals were in the area of influence.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed effect stuttering of damaged buildings.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixing a bug where the list of animals on the map would not be cleared when starting a new game.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Settlers will now visit the pavilion and memorial.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed plantations and fields not removing crops correctly after a savegame upgrade.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed odd plantation placement and moved plantation trees to new positions in older saved games.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed missing icon highlights for certain world tasks.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Buildings now get repaired to be functional again if not all resources for an upgrade are available at the moment.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed expedition taking the wrong items when going to a resource ruin.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed several placeholder errors in expeditions.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed missing localization in diner story.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed error when loading a savegame when the expedition was on its way back from an infinite resource ruin.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Undiscovered ruins from older savegames are no longer discovered when loading the save game.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed bad line breaking in expedition window.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Ruins are now always markable for dismantling from inside the expedition window.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed error when expedition post inventory does not have enough space for all looted resources.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed error when starting an expedition when expedition post inventory is full.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Fixed view issue when scrolling to bottom of expedition configuration's settler list.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Fixed highlighting of settlement inventory items during looting of expeditions.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Attractiveness analytic view now always shows the correct values.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Notification of damaged buildings is now correctly hidden when there are no damaged buildings anymore.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] The placeholder text in search fields is now localized.
[*] [b]UI:[/b] New settlers notification now spawns in all relevant cases.
[*] [b]Scenarios:[/b] Fixed an error when trying to restart a saved scenario.
[*] [b]Wildlife:[/b] Fixed several errors that could result in animals walking over lakes and other path inconsistencies.
[*] [b]Wildlife:[/b] Fixed possibility of only one herd type being on a map.
[*] [b]Savegames:[/b] Fixed an error that could happen right after trying to load a savegame.
[*] [b]System:[/b] Fixed global progress being corrupted, and added reconstruction systems where possible.
[*] [b]System:[/b] Fixed rare issue where the system tries to process autosave-games that are just deleted but still cached by the operating-system
[*] [b]System:[/b] Fixed wrong scenario being initialized when using restart-button on a scenario-savegame
[*] [b]Camera:[/b] Fixed camera animation not playing at the beginning of a scenario/tutorial based on a save game.
[*] [b]Input:[/b] Cancel shortcut (ESC) does nothing when an in game prompt is open.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Fixed broken Tailor malfunction mission.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Cooldowns for side missions are now actually saved in a savegame.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Fixed wrong behavior when counting and solving certain mission goals.
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Fixed error when going back to the tutorial screen after finishing a tutorial.
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed builders not repairing upgraded buildings, even if all requirements and resources were met.
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed too many settlers being able to live in a house.
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] Improved algorithm to find the best suited builder for the next task.
[*] [b]Research:[/b] Fixed Pipe System technology not working on electric wells.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Tutorial:[/b] The expedition tutorial now gives all kinds of tools and clothing, so the player has more options to customize the expedition.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Changed several trigger conditions and rewards for balancing reasons.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Outlander side missions have now been reorganized and don’t require a town center level 3 upgrade anymore. Instead, they can be triggered in the forum and by activating a special decree.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Tweaked several side missions to use a trading window, where you can decide what resources you want to “give away”.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Too many dead people side mission now requires at least one working graveyard.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Several missions now hide their goals, when no goals should be displayed.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Knowledge is Power mission no longer spawns when players have more than 9 tech points.
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Improved localization and UI feedback for side missions with optional solve counts.
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Overhauled the session creation UI for survival mode.
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Minor main menu visual and sound tweaks and polishing.
[*] [b]Main Menu:[/b] Removed or rearranged road map, disclaimer texts and social interaction buttons.

[i]Lynn the Queen | The Unshakable Ago | The Nihilists | Liam The Prophet | Mike the Mega-Devourer[/i]

[h3]Raiders now roam the forests in the world of Endzone, looking for suitable settlements to raid and steal from. Be on the lookout and prepare well![/h3]

There are now 5 different tribes of raiders in the game, which will visit your settlement at different intervals depending on your session settings and demand a tribute. If you don't want to give in to this, or have too few resources available, only combat will help. How high the demands are depends on your progress and the tribe that is in conflict with you. The more prosperous your settlement is and the more settlers there are, the more devastating the raids will be. Each tribe has its own motivations and goals for raiding, so you better not let them get too close to your settlement!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/820a516c3052dc03f5eb48d18991c9bc276fd40f.gif[/img]
[i]Raiders attacking a settlement[/i]

Raiders announce themselves just before an attack and spawn on a random spot on the edge of the map. From there they make their way to your settlement. During the raid, the mob decides for itself where in the settlement it can hit you the hardest. Are your water reserves well stocked? Then you better fear for your food! Also, raiders destroy the buildings they come close to. The deeper the mob can get into your settlement, the more severe the destruction will be.
Raiders can be fought off in three different ways. You can either pay the required tribute and avoid the attack, or you can defend yourself by trying to bring either the health bar or the morale of the mob to 0. For both purposes, new buildings have been added to the research tree, which you can construct for defensive purposes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9798e4386cdb5c92deb30315f3365c53cc00dc7e.png[/img]
[i]Additional research for Defensive Measurements[/i]

[b]Defensive Measures[/b], [b]Watchtowers[/b], [b]Siren Towers[/b] and [b]Barricades[/b] must first be researched. So go on expeditions in time to find the necessary technology before an attack happens and you are completely defenseless.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/70a1dbe46e723d443e505dbe1ed56610871b937c.gif[/img]
[i]Watchtower[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/78104c5f658d75fcc9f5d79a763afcda61d47deb.gif[/img]
[i]Sirene Tower[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/6fcd4d8e36da93e47378c8b4e505cb0983739197.jpg[/img]
[i]Barricades[/i]

[b]Defensive Measures[/b] can be researched to unlock the mining of [b]Sulfur[/b] in the mine. With [b]Sulfur[/b] you'll produce both [b]Metal bullets[/b] and [b]Rubber bullets[/b]. Ammunition can only be made in the [b]Ammunition Factory[/b]. The following recipes are available there:

[list]
[*] [b]Metal bullet:[/b] 1 coal, 1 sulfur, 1 metal = 5 units
[*] [b]Rubber bullet:[/b] 1 coal, 1 sulfur, 1 plastic = 5 units
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/33dc984d828428fcfd51de5ffecac446d0de20bb.jpg[/img]
[i]Ammunition Factory[/i]

Both types of ammunition can be used by [b]Militias[/b] in [b]Watchtowers[/b] to shoot at the raiders. Metal bullets decrease the life meter of the mob, rubber bullets decrease its morale. The type of ammunition you want to use to repel the raiders can be set individually in each tower. 

[b]Siren Towers[/b] are not occupied by settlers, but only require a connection to a power grid. As soon as the raiders enter the siren's radius of action, their morale is lowered. So always make sure that a siren tower has power even at night. Wind turbines that are exclusively available for the tower are particularly suitable for this purpose.

[b]Barricades[/b] can also be erected to reduce the attackers' movement speed. If these are well placed, you can delay the advance into the center of the settlement and give your militia the opportunity to defeat the mob before it arrives. In the best case scenario, the raider won’t even proceed far enough to damage any buildings.

As soon as the health bar or morale of the raiders drops to 0, they will take flight and head back to the edge of the map. After leaving the map, you will get an overview of the last attack. It shows how many buildings were damaged and how many resources were stolen from the settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/78d6a1e61ee2d74075507de2ccb1888aed0c5e8f.png[/img]
[i]Health bar, morale and looted resources in the Raider UI[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/2d92feb6848ba6d5b75f2cb81f395c99784997ed.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/297bbe692536747eab8ac1b92aa690dfbd62fab1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/de16edcd8ea639cfad27edec2b094f7f77e3acaa.jpg[/img]

[i][list]
[*] The release build includes a big release update with brand new gameplay features, targeted especially at the late game.
[*] We’ll further support the game with bug fixes and Quality of Life improvements. We know that you’ll want to give us feedback especially on the newly introduced features and we’ll still be all eyes and ears about that.
[*] However, in the following months, there won’t be big new feature updates as there were during Early Access.
[*] We’ll also start working on a classical “add-on” which is targeted to also come out in 2021. We already have some great ideas for that. But, as always, we’d love your ideas and feedback of what you would like to see.
[/list][/i]

notes.title: 1.395 Trees planted in Malawi!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings, survivors![/b][/h2]

Through the [b]"Save The World" Editions[/b] sold in January and February 2021, we were able to plant [b]1.395 trees[/b] again!

This time in Malawi to restore indigenous forest trees to the landscape in cooperation with communities while installing water wells and pumps, as well as fruit trees. Planting in combination with sustainable development goals tackles the roots of deforestation by taking pressure off mature trees and educating local women how to build fuel efficient clay brick stoves to save firewood and improve their lives.


You can find more information on the website of our partner: https://onetreeplanted.org/collections/africa/products/malawi

Thanks again to our awesome community and everyone who decided to buy the [b]"Save The World" Edition[/b], we could again do our part to make the world a little greener. Because for each edition sold, we plant a real tree. In total, we already planted [b]41.707[/b] trees around the world, together with the non-profit organization "One Tree Planted".

notes.title: Endzone - A World Apart Early Access Recap Trailer released!
notes.content:
Survivors!
It’s been a long and occasionally radioactive road, but the end of the Early Access period for our Endzone - A World Apart, is right around the corner. 
After selling an impressive [b]150,000 units[/b] during Early Access, on March 18, 2021, the game will see a full launch on Windows PC and Mac via Steam and GOG. 

To celebrate this amazing milestone, we have released a handy and informative ‘Recap Trailer’ that sums up all the incredible accomplishments and updates the game has received during Early Access and together with the amazing help of the Endzone-Community!

[h3]Additionally, we are also pleased to announce that the game will be receiving its first exciting new expansion later this year![/h3]

Throughout the Early Access period, we have been all-hands-on-deck providing fixes, patches, and content expansions to keep you players busy in the survival of your post-apocalyptic colonies. 
During this time, we released a whopping [b]11 major updates[/b], [i][b]adding new mechanics, buildings, environmental hazards, equipment, branching skill trees, and more[/b][/i]. 
To help everyone keep up with all the progress, the new trailer gives you a glimpse into the game’s progress from April to now, detailing the [b]100+ new side missions, 24 new expeditions, 33 new buildings, countless patches and fixes, and of course, the 40,300+ trees planted as a result of the partnership with One Tree Planted.[/b]

[h3]Watch the ‘Early Access Recap’ trailer here:[/h3]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pmZ68FNa8Sk


[h3]Save the World Edition[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f6535bf35155402120176bc84c86fffd142a727f.png[/img]
In case you missed it, we have also teamed up with the charitable organization [b]One Tree Planted[/b] to plant a tree for every Save the World Edition bundle purchase. 
[b]In addition, players that buy the Save the World bundle will also receive a free copy of the game’s stellar soundtrack! [/b]

notes.title: Collect & Explore Update | Available Now | Release: 18th March 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/6152eb5a5105e0e85d3fbf8139a230df91750b29.gif[/img]

[b]Dear fellow Survivors![/b]

Some time has passed since Endzone - A World Apart started into Early Access in April last year. It has been an incredible journey and we are just awestruck by our great community and the rich feedback we got from you all. We already stated earlier that our Early Access period will be roughly a year and we stand by this claim, which is why Endzone releases as a full game on 18th of March this year. For this reason, we will interrupt our regular pace of one major update per month and dedicate our resources to optimization, improvement and, most importantly, working on brand new features for our release update, which is why there will be no further update in February. To not leave you hanging, a Community Preview will be made available in February, where you can also enjoy some of the bug fixes and improvements that will be part of our release version. We understand that for some of you our news might come as a surprise (we didn’t talk too much about our release date), as you might have thought that our early access period might be even longer.

We think that our game has matured tremendously over the whole development and especially since the start of its Early Access period. Development has been driven and influenced by what you had to say and wished for, which often matched our own vision but sometimes gave us a completely new perspective on what to prioritize on. It is hard for us to let go and we think that you might share this feeling with us, so we’d like to let you know what will happen to Endzone and what you can expect from us during 2021.

[list]
[*] With the release on 18th March 2021, Endzone will get a big release update, including brand new gameplay features, targeted especially at the late game.
[*] After that we’ll support the game with bug fixes and Quality of Life improvements. We know that you’ll want to give us feedback especially on the newly introduced features and we’ll still be all eyes and ears about that.
[*] However, in the following months, there won’t be big new feature updates as there were during Early Access.
[*] The team will focus on evaluating and eventually start porting the game to modern consoles, with time and resources spent on a good user interface. If all goes well, the PC version of the game might also receive gamepad support.
[*] At the same time, we’ll start working on a classical “add-on” which is targeted to also come out in 2021. We already have some ideas for that but as always we’d love your ideas and feedback of what you would like to see.
[/list]

As always, we’d love to hear from you and what you have to think about this.

[i]Stay Healthy,
Your teams from Gentlymad & Assemble[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Added several special buildings and technologies that can now be collected during expeditions or doing side missions.
[*][b]Research:[/b] Added 2 new technologies to reduce the penalty of placing Wells and Fishing Huts next to each other.
[*][b]Research:[/b] Added technology to increase the inventory size of explorers.
[*][b]Research:[/b] Added new stories to Military Base, Fast Food Restaurant, Construction Site and Harvester.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added 2 new decorative buildings, that can be unlocked via side missions and expeditions: Memorial and Pavilion.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added 5 new decorative streetlamps.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added an upgrade for the tailor building that doubles the possible workforce and provides a better production efficiency.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added an upgrade for the workshop building that doubles the possible workforce and provides a better production efficiency.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added a new ruin type, the police station.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Added additional info for all buildings of the same type directly in the scene. This gives an overview of all buildings that use the same recipe. Additionally, you can now change the current recipe without having to click on the object beforehand. You can toggle this info in the lower HUD and in the game settings.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Implemented Research missions for the upgraded tailor and the upgraded workshop.
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] Added a new scenario: “Dark Times” where you have to rebuild a nearly destroyed settlement. This also includes a new achievement for finishing the scenario.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Visitors now leave the building if the condition of a building is 0%.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Prevent builders from being blocked too long in medical facilities.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed error that prevented buildings from upgrading.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Research equipment marker is no longer falsely shown in a story dialogue if enough research utensils were already collected.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed “Mark for salvaging”-button of ruin not showing while the inspector is open after an expedition returned.
[*][b]Trader:[/b] Fixed time until the next trader arrives not being shown.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed an error that could occur when tasks could not be spawned.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed a bug when creating tasks for settlers and their inventory was nearly full.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Hunter don’t tranquilize more animals if there are already tranquilized animals lying around.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] “Strange Explorers” and “Unknown Researchers” side missions now are instantly solved if the player has reached 1.000 expedition rations.
[*][b]Performance:[/b] Big performance boost when playing with higher game speed.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Explorers no longer discard their radiation protection if the player selected “None” for tools (and vice versa).
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Removed research utensils from two Greenhouse stories which should not have been there.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed possible bug where, after an expedition was cancelled, the explorers gathered too early, causing an error.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed expedition not starting in some cases when Expedition Post was missing resources.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed Action Points not calculated correctly if Expedition Rations were requested as advantage.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Amount of ruins with research utensils left can no longer become negative if ruins are removed by the player. 
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Logic no longer tries to remove Expedition Rations from the explorer’s inventory when cancelling a resource expedition.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Side missions unlocking a random technology no longer unlock technologies blocked by not yet gathered research utensils.
[*][b]Pathfinding:[/b] Fixed settlers not walking across a dismantled building’s area.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Builders are not “hammering” on a construction site anymore, when they are currently only bringing resources to it.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Pioneer Statue is now a decorative building that is unique.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added ability for shelters & upgraded shelters to select which type of settlers can live in them, you can choose between “All Settlers” or “Old & Infertile”.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added ability to switch between building variants when there are several variants of one building available. This works with: Cabins, Sturdy Houses, Food Counter, Water Tap, Streetlamps and Flags.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Decorations that are locked are now completely hidden in the build menu.
[*][b]UI:[/b] The technology window button in the HUD now displays the progress of ongoing technology research (if active).
[*][b]UI:[/b] The roadmap now has a higher resolution and a better initial scrolling position.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Improved the explorer dialogue layout.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Removed the inventory tab from houses and shelters as it is not needed any longer.
[*][b]UI:[/b] The inventory tab of Pastures now allows to set the collection sources for water. However, in order to have the UI available for already built Pastures in older save games it’s necessary to demolish and rebuild them.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Save game descriptions can now be confirmed by hitting enter.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Hitting enter now triggers the next possible action in the expedition window, depending on the state the selected ruin is currently in (Possible actions are: Send scout, setup expedition and instruct expedition).
[*][b]Environment:[/b] Grass now immediately regrows when a building or a ruin is removed.
[*][b]Research:[/b] Stew and Cake recipes must now be researched.
[*][b]Research:[/b] Increased cooldown of “Unscheduled Types of Research” and “Field Testing” side missions.
[*][b]Research:[/b] Improved layout of the technology tree.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Confidence needs to be higher for Catastrophe Missions to trigger.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Instead of a radar, there is now a list of ongoing and active scouting missions.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Updated the visuals of the expedition post.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Finished locations are now checkmarked in the Expedition window and can no longer be automatically dismantled (players can still mark them for salvaging).
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] If all locations are fully completed the Expedition window gives feedback accordingly.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Gathering explorers and gathering resources now happens simultaneously when starting an expedition. 
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Completely overhauled the expedition window. Every ruin now features specific icons, displayed on the radar as soon as they have been scouted, so it’s easier to distinguish between them. It’s also possible now to navigate to ruins using camera controls.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Expeditions are no longer canceled because an Explorer died. (Explorers are now immortal directly after starting an expedition.)
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Made expedition preparation faster. If available, expedition rations are now automatically assigned to a currently collecting expedition without a scout having to actively do it.
[*][b]Survival Mode:[/b] The default sandstorm damage has been increased from low to medium.
[*][b]Electricity:[/b] The analytic view for electricity now tints connections based on the current grid state (power flowing, overloaded, not connected).
[*][b]Forester Lodge:[/b] Updated the visuals of the Forester Lodge.
[*][b]Food Station:[/b] Food Station now has a quick preview of the stored amount of food.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ec24c6b5efe3d99ce3ed2c8ca69509be7727a983.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Expeditions that are currently gathering at the expedition post or that are currently gathering resources will be cancelled when loading savegames from before this update to avoid bugs in the new expedition preparation behavior.
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] If the survivor, found at the end of the hospital story, dies, an icon indicating that a technology or a building can be found in the hospital ruin, is displayed in the expedition window, even if none can be found in that case.
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] If the technologies for higher efficiency for buildings with overlapping working areas were researched in a game round and a new game is started from this game round, the raised efficiency values for the corresponding buildings are not reset correctly.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/27e99a8af46a836196ca81251842d0d3e710fb75.gif[/img]

In Endzone, the introduction of decorations not only meant that a completely new factor had to be permanently considered and planned for, but also that you could now make your settlement more personal and homely.
With this update comes a whole 7 new decorations, of which 5 different variations of [b]Street Lamps[/b] are possible. While the [b]Street Lamps[/b] can be built right from the start, the new decorative buildings can only be found in your construction menu once you have made the corresponding progress in the settlement. In addition, these buildings can only be built once each, so you should think carefully about where to build the new [b]Pavillon[/b] and [b]Memorial[/b]!

notes.title: 1.063 Trees planted in the Amazon Rainforest!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings, survivors![/b][/h2]

Through the [b]"Save The World" Editions[/b] sold in December, we were able to plant [b]1.063 trees[/b] again!
This time in the Amazon Rainforest to help conserve habitat for its iconic wildlife species, provide sustainable livelihoods to local people, and stabilize the climate. The Amazon Rainforest can hold around 90-140 billion metric tons of carbon and plays a critical role in the fight against climate change.

You can find more information on the website of our partner: https://onetreeplanted.org/collections/latin-america/products/amazon-rainforest

Thanks again to our awesome community and everyone who decided to buy the [b]"Save The World" Edition[/b], we could again do our part to make the world a little greener. Because for each edition sold, we plant a real tree. In total, we already planted [b]40.312[/b] trees around the world, together with the non-profit organization "One Tree Planted".

notes.title: Research Equipment Update | Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a630dff3bca92f383248e517155450a690f38aa3.gif[/img]

[b]Dear survivors,[/b]

[i]as an early Christmas present we now release the last update of Endzone for the year. Thanks to every one of you for the dedicated support, love and all the important feedback. We are humbled and truly grateful for that. Additional thanks to everyone who took the time to report feedback or bugs via email, STOMT or as part of the discussions on the Steam forums or our Discord server. This is super helpful to us.

Have the best possible Christmas in the current situation and stay safe!

Cheers,
Gentlymad[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

The last update for this year focuses on some requests that have been floating around the community for a long time, coupled with some fixes and changes to existing systems.
As you probably know by now, we take your feedback and suggestions to heart. Since this update comes a bit earlier than usual due to the winter break, we obviously couldn't include as much content as usual. So we focused on extending existing systems and crafting a so-called "quality of life" patch, so that the short development time is balanced by long-wanted features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Extended main tutorial with a new mission for the Water Point building.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Added 3 new tutorial modules: ‘Research’, ‘Radiation’ and ‘Water’.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added the Electric Water Pump. This is an upgrade to the Well and doesn’t require any manual labor.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added Water Point, a small building used to act as a place where settlers can go, to stock up on water. It’s similar to the Food Station. This building is useful if you have water production facilities far away from other workplaces and need to reduce the walking distances for your settlers.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added tool restrictions to the Town Center. You can now select what kind of tools your settlers are allowed to use.
[*][b]Research:[/b] Added research utensils to the game. These utensils can be found when sending expeditions to ruins and other interesting places. Utensils are mandatory to progress in the technology tree. Look out especially for large and big ruins, as they are most likely to house these precious artifacts!
[*][b]Research:[/b] Added overhauled research window. The new window features several usability improvements, makes better use of the overall screen space and displays your current research tier and the amount of collected research utensils.
[*][b]General:[/b] Added 29 new potential village names, when creating a new session.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Added Electric Water Pump and Loitering Ban research missions.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Added one new music track.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed bug related to settlers when choosing a workplace near their home.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixing settlers flagged as homeless after loading a game.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed settlers not being distributed during or after pausing the game.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Increase Builder Profession Button is now no longer interactable if there are no free workers left.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed builders being removed as inhabitant from their own house while repairing it.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Added periodical check and correction for settlers with invalid homes.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed a wrong profession distribution on savegames.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed performance lag in repair logic if needed resources were reserved and not available.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed started repair tasks not being properly finished.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Several fixes to the workplace assignment behavior.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed builders being blocked by buildings that haven’t got all required resources.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed broken tooltip in construction info.
[*][b]UI:[/b] End Screens are now triggered correctly in scenarios and tutorials.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed several broken hover highlights.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed incorrect settler selection in settler dialog. 
[*][b]UI:[/b] Save Game Menu now empties the description field every time it’s opened.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Seed selection now highlights the seed and displays the tooltip correctly.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed missing text caused by the typewriting effect in settler dialogs.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed graphic of loading screen radiation sign.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed post pro effects and bad scaling of particle systems in the main menu.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed vanishing pie charts in Statistics.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Tooltips for changing production limits no longer overlap with the actual values.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed wrong display of negative resource amounts.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Fixing wrong animal herd types stored in savegame in case the herd types on the map change for some reason.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Fixed error related to the Pasture and statistics.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Fixed a problem with dying animals: when one animal died, another animal left the Pasture and a third one came in.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Fixed dead animals not being removed from Pastures when no species was set.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Fixed error when dismantling a Pasture.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Fixing animal slaughtering when clearing Pasture.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed wrong button label in Water Tower.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed error in electricity networks.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed broken visuals on construction site ruin.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed visuals of tomato seed.
[*][b]General:[/b] Fixed possible error when loading a savegame, related to the load system.
[*][b]General:[/b] Fixed error with empty resource piles not being removed correctly.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Fixed shelter click sound.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Fixed an error that caused tutorial missions to show wrong goals, when loading older, uncompleted tutorial savegames.
[*][b]Wildlife:[/b] Wildlife is not spawned in a straight line anymore.
[*][b]Wildlife:[/b] Added a minimum spawn distance for wildlife to the town center, to avoid spawning herds into the bus.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed wrong advantage in gas station expedition.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Builders now grab ongoing tasks when clearing construction sites.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Adjusted builders to get hunger/thirst slower and work longer.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Tweaked spawning behavior of repair tasks to be building dependent.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Restrict the amount of spawned worker tasks to 20 per building/world task, to avoid scenarios, where a lot of workers would try to do the same task which was not very efficient.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Settlers now only get food or water after completing a job.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Left side of the statistics tab is now scrollable when needed.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Game Overlays now (un-)pause the game when they are (de-)activated.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Some adjustments to the main menu item selection.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Improved several checkboxes for better readability.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Map Seed and Village name are now randomized each time the session menu is opened.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Reduced sandstorm damage to medium on ‘Hard Mode’ preset.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Added settlers to the main menu, to make it feel more alive.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Player can no longer change game speed while in “destroy resources” prompt.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Slices of Pie Charts in statistics are now highlighted more prominently.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Improved click detection for placing buildings. This should avoid accidental misplacement of buildings.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Changed keyboard mapping for toggling through analytic view/heat maps to avoid issues with standard mappings for game overlays.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] UI entries in the building inspector are now hidden, if the corresponding building hasn’t been unlocked yet.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Set all harvest cycles for plantation trees to 8 cycles.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Irrigation Plant no longer resets its irrigation level to None if paused.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fill level of the water gauge now shows the amount of ‘reserved’ water.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Removed ambience sounds from Fields and Plantations.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Kitchen now correctly shows ‘Missing Raw Food’ as a warning.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added coal as a potential resource in the market.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Pub now uses any kind of fruit for ‘Hard Liquor’ instead of only berries.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Pasture inspector now outputs correct value for stored water if there is no water in the inventory yet.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Animals marked for slaughter now wait for the herder before they leave the pasture after clearing the pasture or changing the species.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Added two more working paths and made the existing ones blocking.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Animal selection now stays with the last selected animal instead of switching to the next available.
[*][b]Pasture:[/b] Meat and produced goods on pastures can now be radiated. Radiation is based on the supplied water and its radiation value.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Removed resource label from Expedition Rewards as the text clipped in several languages and the new approach is more streamlined.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Improved layout of expedition inventory during expeditions.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Added a settlement inventory to the loot screen at expeditions.
[*][b]Research:[/b] Required knowledge points are now colored in red if there are not enough points available in the tech tree window. 
[*][b]Savegame:[/b] In the savegame slots in the Load Game screen you can now double-click on the screenshot in order to load the corresponding savegame.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Changed tutorial map.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/2e56f5b507c041c016d7bb29d391753dd732672f.png[/img]
[i]New Tutorial starting point. Every part of the tutorial features a new, specially created Map.[/i]

[*][b]Environment:[/b] Optimized the tree system to gain more overall performance.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Tweaked global ambience volumes.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Technology side missions now respect the amount of collected research utensils before triggering.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Traders now no longer bring special resources with them when they have only medium reputation.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/27e99a8af46a836196ca81251842d0d3e710fb75.gif[/img]

Two new buildings have been added with this update. The [b]Electric Water Pump[/b] and the [b]Water Point[/b] both serve to optimize and ensure the water supply within the settlement. Together with the new settler behavior, these buildings should complement the gameplay and make it more logical. Settlers now only walk away from the work site to satisfy one need at a time, such as food or drink. The [b]Food Station[/b] previously allowed the need for food to be logistically moved to work locations already. The [b]Water Point[/b] now serves the same purpose, only for water. The [b]Water Point[/b] also needs logisticians to move water from any source to the desired building.
In connection with this, the [b]Electric Water Pump[/b] represents an upgrade to the [b]Well[/b], through which automatic and above all permanent delivery of clear water is possible. Although the pump must be connected to the power grid in order to operate, it acts autonomously and without labor. A combination of both buildings is especially suitable for the lategame and can therefore not be built easily, but needs to be unlocked through research first.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f2824caf3ce872e98e61b9fb0008a75458620ace.png[/img]
[i]Water Point[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/35618a1dd543a2f0577b6bbf5243bb390d76261e.png[/img]
[i]You can decide from which sources logisticians collect water to put it into the Water Point
[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/04dd6d39c701fd41960a8c0556fee532cce7166c.gif[/img]
[i]Electric Water Pump[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/5eef2e2dace8e6aca49507cf61e7fa5a42186f7f.gif[/img]

Research has been part of the game for some updates now and continues to be constantly added to with new content and equally restructured to give direction to the game speed and natural progression. Due to the great feedback on the expedition system and its "simplicity", we are now combining both systems. Expeditions were rarely used by many players nowadays or were mainly used to get new seeds. By introducing progress stages in the technology tree, research can now only be done if a certain prerequisite is met. This is the collection of so-called [b]Research Utensils[/b]. This fictitious resource can only be obtained through expeditions and can be thought of as finding a blueprint for new technologies. To get to the advanced buildings in the technology tree, expeditions have to be mastered successfully and thoughtfully. After new [b]Research Utensils[/b] have been found, a new research level is unlocked. So always be on the lookout for big ruins if you want to reach a new technological level. [b]Side Note: The Electric Water Pump is hidden on the highest technology level![/b]

[b]Please be aware, that for existing save games, the maximum number of utensils will already be unlocked.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/6aae7711374d11b26c9fbd6a93c8cef08916a365.png[/img]
[i]The new Research Window[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/6bdf6ea216efbdd651674492d6596bafb1949dfb.gif[/img]
[i]Progressing technology levels[/i]

notes.title: Livestock Update | Now available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/cbdbf4099e31f9bd28db31b8ab04c8bc07fd7fee.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]

In the ninth update for Endzone it is possible for the first time not only to hunt animals in the wild, but also to catch them and keep them in pastures implemented for this purpose. Four completely new species of animals now roam the radioactive forests of Endzone, offering a much wider range of food than just their meat. In addition, the settler behavior has been reworked again and allows to understand their actions much easier and to better integrate them into the natural flow of the game. Players should not only notice a boost in efficiency, but also be "rewarded" by a logical settlement structure, leading to a well balanced settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added a Pasture, allowing you to raise and keep animals as another steady food source. Animals on the pasture need water to survive, which is supplied by herders. You can control and customize the behavior of the Pasture to your liking, deciding to butcher animals or only harvest their produce.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added 2 new work modes to the Hunting Lodge. Wild animals can now be caught by the Hunter. Be aware that only 2 different species of animals will appear on the map, but you can find animals of other species by trading.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added a Food Counter. This building is part of the logistic buildings and it lets you redistribute food to places, where it is really needed or not readily available. A logistician assigned to the Food Counter will look for food inside the working area, fetching and storing it in the building’s inventory. You can also decide which food types should be stored.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added new visuals for the normal school building to relate better to the Advanced School.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added new settler badge for herder.
[*][b]Animals:[/b] Added sounds to all animal species.
[*][b]Animals:[/b] Added 4 new animal species: Buffaloes, Hares, Chickens, and Goats. Every new map seed features 2 randomly picked animals from all available species including deer and boars.
[*][b]Animals:[/b] Added different properties for all animal species. All animals provide different types of meat. Some species also produce additional resources like Milk or Eggs. Furthermore, every species yields different amounts of meat and has its own reproduction rate.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Added animals to the special goods inventory of several traders. Traders will only carry animals that you can’t find on the map.
[*][b]Resources:[/b] Added 2 new recipes to the kitchen: Cake and Stew. Both resources offer different effects when consumed. Eating a cake will give a bonus in confidence, while consuming Stew will regenerate your settlers’ health.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Added a new Tutorial for food production. This tutorial offers a comprehensive overview of all the different ways of producing and distributing food.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Added prioritization options for settlers to prioritize certain types of tasks: Build, Build Streets and Repair. This can be adjusted in the Town Center, using Drag and Drop.
[*][b]Music:[/b] Added another music track, which plays back in “normal” gameplay situations.
[*][b]Decrees:[/b] Added a new decree: “Loitering Ban”. With this decree, your settlers will stop visiting their homes to gain confidence and avoid any leisure activities, making them very efficient but also unhappy.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Added new popup window to easily solve conflicts when the player tries to prioritize the construction or repair of multiple buildings.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Added 2D avatars for roaming animals.
[*][b]Fields:[/b] Added a new seed: Black Salsify. This seed replaces the roots resource, which could not be acquired by any production building.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/7051132abdffbc07e2e664363cea5be3a7764c75.png[/img]
[i]Black Salsify on a cultivated field[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed Scrap Totem click sound, which used a wrong sound file.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed a bug in the Hunting Lodge that could result in hunters still killing animals, when the production limit for food was already reached.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Lowered volume of Fields ambience sound.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed bug in field-of-influence-check for several buildings like the Market.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Several fixes that prevented building of streets.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Gatherer Hut is no longer looking for roots.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed source selection of irrigation plants not being available on old savegames.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Game is now paused if the endscreen of a scenario is opened.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Fixed that players can go back into the game by pressing ESC in the Main Menu when they have a completed tutorial session in the background.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed missing sound cue when starting a new game session.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Removed misleading UI sound when clicking on buttons.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Toggling Repair on/off using the keyboard shortcut now only works ingame and not e.g. while typing the savegame name in the main menu.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Only paying with food now also changes the reputation with traders.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Fixed “Start Trade” button being interactable, even if the deal is considered as unfair.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Fixed food not removed correctly if traded with a specific food resource.
[*][b]Environment:[/b] Fixed issues with first plants still stacking on top of each other under certain conditions.
[*][b]Environment:[/b] Forest Plants without a parent tree will slowly shrink and vanish, fixing save games that experienced the first plant stacking bug.
[*][b]Savegames:[/b] A new game id is now created when clicking “restart” in the main menu. This way, new savegames receive their own game slot.
[*][b]Localization:[/b] Several grammar and typo fixes for German localization.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed wrong labeling when settlers are idling in certain cases.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Settlers are no longer visiting their home for food and water. Instead, settlers satisfy their needs for food and water by searching for the nearest collection point or storage. This boosts the overall efficiency of settlers, as it reduces time spent walking back and forth between homes and workplaces.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Settlers will now visit their homes periodically to relax and chill, gaining a boost in confidence for a certain amount of time.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Settlers now use a more complex system when assigning themselves to workplaces and homes. This should result in less job switching and shorter walking distances.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Changed behavior of Repair and Build Next button. Tasks are no longer stacked and should be executed faster. If your streets are built too slow, please use the prioritization in the Town Center instead.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Settlers now try to get all resources they need in one go if the building they are visiting has several resources they need. Before, settlers would visit the same building several times to acquire their resources one by one.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Reworked filtering options when setting up an expedition.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Added a new notification when a ruin was scouted.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Big performance boost for the expeditions' setup window.
[*][b]Animals:[/b] Animal species spawned on the map are now bound to the map seed.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Changed the tutorial map to use a specific savegame instead of a seed.
[*][b]Graveyard:[/b] Bumped up the number of maximum morticians from 3 to 10.
[*][b]Decrees:[/b] Removed the graveyard decree, as it was misleading and often misused and did not offer the expected benefit.
[*][b]Diseases:[/b] Randomized settler selection when a disease breaks out.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] The Irrigation Plant now highlights its worker paths.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Street building tasks are now broken down to chunks of tasks, to make building streets more efficient. 
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Rain Collectors now show the Turnover Tab.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Production buildings now give additional information about the settlers working in it, such as showing the tools they are using, their educational status, and so on.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Generating a fair trade now takes reputation into account.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Trading Window now displays the available inventory of the trading post and warns the player if a trade cannot be concluded when there’s not enough inventory space.
[*][b]Trading:[/b] Improved layout of Trade Window.
[*][b]UI:[/b] ‘Quit Game’ button now only prompts the player if he really wants to quit, if the session was not previously saved in the main menu.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Re-enabled hotkey to (de-)activate repairs.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Changed sorting of several buildings in the Buildings Tab.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Added a warning to the “Repair Next” button if repair is currently disabled.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Changed Start Button Sound to a more rewarding one.
[*][b]Achievements:[/b] Reduced achievement progression intervals, so that achievement progress isn’t triggered as often, which was especially noticeable in the main tutorial.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ec24c6b5efe3d99ce3ed2c8ca69509be7727a983.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Buildings: The new school visuals require you to destroy and build a new school, if you want it to connect to the power grid correctly.
[*]Savegame: Some savegames made during the Community Preview might throw an error related to the Pasture. We’ll try to address this in an upcoming Hotfix.
[*]Settlers: Pausing a building while it is under construction (all resources have already been brought to the building) and then re-enabling the construction, the building is not constructed any further. We’ll try to address this in an upcoming Hotfix.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ae00c1e2c28d7c4d2c306d8e77ecc336a42c0136.gif[/img]

Through the pasture, roaming animals can now finally be kept and raised in the Endzone. The hunter is now able not only to hunt animals, but also to capture them as needed and store them in the Hunter's Lodge until a Herder picks them up and brings them to the pasture.
Held animals naturally need a certain amount of food and water to survive and reproduce on the pasture.
Animals can be slaughtered inside the pasture and thus be processed into meat. How many animals are to be slaughtered can be set in the building UI of the pasture. In order to avoid having to catch animals again, a minimum limit can be set for the number of animals to be slaughtered. Buffalo, goats and chickens can also provide eggs and milk for further processing in addition to meat.
Individual animal species take up different amounts of space on a pasture, which results in the following maximum numbers for keeping animals:

[list]
[*] Hares and chickens: 10 units
[*] Goats and wild boars: 7 units
[*] Buffalo and deer: 5 units
[/list]

Reproduction time and yield differ for individual animal species similarly to different seeds in the fields and therefore require the player to find an optimal balance. In addition to catching them in the wild, Traders can now also bring a new type of animal if the reputation is high enough, so keep an eye out for that!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/70ea65fb571ed6fe6a9a78e5494b096deb642f55.png[/img]
[i]The pasture and some boars[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/77aaee1a7d538ff9bbbab3f2a7da628b08c28d2a.png[/img]
[i]UI window of the pasture showing the possibilities you have in the building[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/2318ef30e28884793439710c7e058a7b5eada7de.png[/img]
[i]Buffaloes, Chickens, Goats and Hares[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/27e99a8af46a836196ca81251842d0d3e710fb75.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/d07cd65d49e90c21cb6227abaae2b26098d98fe4.png[/img]
[i]The Food Counter in action[/i]

The new Food Counter complements the revised behavior of the settlers. They generally prefer the shortest distance to a building where they can get food. The Food Counter can now be built near production facilities and gives food to hungry settlers. Inside the building, the player can choose what kind of food should be provided. Logisticians are responsible for collecting food from the specified area of influence and bringing it to the Food Counter. With the new recipes in the kitchen, it is also possible to determine more precisely what effect a Food Counter will have at the desired location.
[list]
[*] Stew saturates settlers and gives them a little buff on their health if it is not completely filled.
[*] Cake also saturates settlers, but makes them a little happier.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/e4ecb2c24db1e9340e9c4350cbe7147138680728.png[/img]
[i]UI window of the Food Counter showing the different options[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f6e5f8a7ce04fa271f7d499387e642e8463595da.gif[/img]

The behavior of the settlers is elementary for a functioning settlement and is therefore regularly examined and permanently optimized by us. Among other things, your feedback made it clear that there were no technical errors in the behavior of the settlers, but logical ones. The adapted behavior not only makes it more obvious to the player when which decisions are made, but these decisions now have a much more positive effect on the growth and preservation of the settlement.
Previously, settlers stopped their current tasks as soon as a vital need had to be met. This is still the case, but settlers now use the path they have travelled to satisfy all needs at once. In this sense, water supply and food intake no longer function separately, thus halving the number of ways they take to sustain life. Additionally, settlers now visit their homes in their spare time to get a small boost to their confidence and use it for reproduction. Also the autonomous allocation of jobs now works more precisely, so that fewer job changes take place overall without negatively affecting efficiency.

The priorities of the settlers in their building behavior have also been adjusted. In the Towncenter, the construction method that should be prioritized over the others can now be determined by drag & drop. This means that the expansion or maintenance of the settlement can now be sensitively controlled.

Road construction has also changed fundamentally. While settlers used to like to build just one piece of a road and then do other things, they now work through so-called "chunks". These are pre-defined "blocks" or areas of a road, which means that they are built faster and more reliably overall.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/297bbe692536747eab8ac1b92aa690dfbd62fab1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/c8a7bf0b0230117f522b2b8b460b01cb9883f414.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/worldofendzone][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/857c6611858f47a4fa7b6b44aedbaf572b46ff1e.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/933820/announcements/detail/2910969711808371938][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f6535bf35155402120176bc84c86fffd142a727f.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/933820/announcements/detail/2910969711808802005][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/7698a58f58bdb965bac65092dcd7f78cf9c2ac67.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3lhMAH6Dz3g

We know that there are still some things we need to fix, and we are listening to your feedback. We try to address all important issues in a timely manner and make the game as a whole more understandable and fair. However, it is important to note that Endzone - A World Apart is a survival game. Challenging gameplay, as well as a difficult learning curve, are intended and are designed to provide the player with a difficult task.

[i]- Your team from Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment[/i]

notes.title: Trade & Barter Update - Now Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/49feb580e66d038c1b867ed21d2d365d6d1a8eab.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]

The eighth major update for [b]Endzone - A World Apart[/b] allows trading with characters from other, far away settlements for the first time. The new [b]Trading Post[/b] opens up new possibilities to deal with the resources in Endzone. Too much medicine was produced during a disease wave? - Trade with [b]Susan Melfi[/b] and exchange your surplus for new seeds and a little cloth! [b]5 different merchants[/b] travel around your settlement. How fair your offers are to the travelers determines how well your relationship with them develops.
The education of your settlers has also been raised to a new level. An expanded school system allows you to choose specialized education paths. With the [b]Advanced School[/b], your settlers can even be educated in all areas at the same time and thus become even more effective.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added 5 different and unique traders with their own personality and a unique hot air balloon. Every trader has unique traits, is interested in different goods and will also offer you a distinctive set of goods. They also remember your trading history and will react to the fairness of the deals you made with them. Making fair and good deals might result in new seeds or even technology points for research.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added a Trading Post that allows for trading goods with different traders. 
[*][b]Technology:[/b] Added a new technology that allows you to choose which trader will visit you next.
[*][b]Tutorials:[/b] Added 2 new tutorial sections. This is our first push to give you dedicated tutorials in addition to the big, comprehensive tutorial. New features, like the Trading Post can now be learned without the hassle of going through the complete tutorial. Additionally we also created a new dedicated tutorial for the Confidence system.
[*][b]Advanced School:[/b] The advanced school is a new building that allows your students to reach all the available learning topics. This is an addition to the rework of the education system.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] As part of the education system rework, clicking on settlers will now show their learning progression towards the four different topics.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] 2 new expeditions were added, including a Bar and a shop building.
[*][b]Environment:[/b] Several new ruin types were added, including machinery for agriculture and a construction site.
[*][b]Options:[/b] Added a new option to restrict the mouse cursor to the active game window. Useful, when you have a multi monitor setup, where one screen is idle.
[*][b]Options:[/b] Added an options to disable/enable cloud rendering in the game options.
[*][b]Music:[/b] Added 2 new music tracks to the game.
[*][b]Seeds:[/b] Added 2 new seeds to the game. Sugar beet and Lupines.
[*][b]Glossary:[/b] Added and refactored several glossary entries for education and trading.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed decontamination post not showing when the max cap is reached.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed the area highlighting for the decontamination post.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed rendering of decrees on the Forum.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Decontamination Kits can no longer be radiated.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed level of detail visuals for Gatherers Cabin.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed a bug in the Decontamination Post causing loaded savegames to lose their decontamination kits.
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] Buildings are now upgradable in a scenario when they were locked at start and unlocked during the scenario. This fixes the bug, where a cistern could not be upgraded to a water tower in the tutorial session.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Fixed several blurry or falsely cropped in-game icons.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Added a sanity check to avoid possible errors when presenting new UI elements.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed age progress in settler inspector.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed an error caused by faulty settler achievements.
[*][b]Resources:[/b] Fixed a bug related to hemp weaving mills that caused hemp to be always fully reserved. If you have saved games where you experience this,  you’ll need to tear down any hemp fields for this fix to take effect.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Fixed well cycling sound, which was way too loud.
[*][b]Technology:[/b] Players can no longer start another research when there's already one running.
[*][b]Savegames:[/b] Fixed memory leaks caused by saving & loading (including autosaves). This should fix a problem where people reported that the RAM got completely filled up.
Localization: Several small localization improvements to german localization based on proofreader feedback.
[*][b]Savegames:[/b] Fixed the 'continue’ button in the main-menu, to continue playing based on the latest savegame.
[*][b]Technology:[/b] Fixed wrong kitchen icon in tech tree.
[*][b]Technology:[/b] Fixed wrong position of advanced technologies in the tech tree.
[*][b]Savegame:[/b] Autosave no longer opens the MainMenu when finished.
[*][b]Glossary:[/b] Glossary no longer moves to the wrong tab at first opening.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Fixed some Side Missions that weren’t working anymore after declining one mission more than three times.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Tutorial no longer highlights the profession window during the quest where you have to build a Forum.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed highlighting of confidence tab in settler inspector.
[*][b]Electricity:[/b] Fixed an error for the electricity toggle when no grid is active.
[*][b]Camera:[/b] Camera is no longer overzealous when setting its target rotation (e.g. when resetting the camera rotation via minimap).
[*][b]Environment:[/b] Fixed bug in Weather system.
Environment: Fixed wrong visuals for several trees.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] 3D visuals of settlers are now correctly displayed, and textures don’t have holes or unwanted effects anymore.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Fixed several ambience sounds that were not playing while they should have.
[*][b]Electricity:[/b] Fixed upgraded buildings being ignored by the current electricity grid.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed wrong offset for ruins in expeditions.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Production Limits:[/b] Increased production limits for decontamination kits from 10 to 30.
[*][b]Production Limits:[/b] Resource Outputs now show a filled "production limit" bar instead of an empty one if the production limit is set to 0.
[*][b]School:[/b] Up to 3 teachers can now be employed in the school.
[*][b]School:[/b] The school has been reworked and it now features different learning topics that can be prioritized. You can choose a specific topic teachers should focus on, resulting in students to learn it faster.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Tweaked and refactored the sound system to have a better and more harmonic ambience soundscape.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Increased max range of 3D one shots and local ambient sounds.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Reduced volume of well/bicycle.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Increased ambient wind volume.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Decreased max ui volume.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Balanced global audio volume.
[*][b]Sounds:[/b] Added several new sound effects to buildings and expeditions.
[*][b]Performance:[/b] Several performance and memory optimizations.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Increased cooldown for Infestation Side Mission.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Increased cooldown of enforced Missions to prevent them from spamming.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Tagged several Side Missions to make it clear that they are part of the confidence system, when selecting from the bulletin board.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Several Side Missions now trigger even if another mission is already active.
[*][b]Repairing:[/b] Tweaked settler task flow when damaged buildings have been repaired.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Changed decree post visuals of the forum, so decrees are better to read.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Settlers now also pickup smaller resource-amounts (less than needed) from resource boxes and collection points, if there are not enough resources available.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Tasks for constructions sites are now prioritized.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Highly educated settlers now get 3 badges instead of 2.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/604f3aaa25e78856efb045dd769b07be3eff17c9.gif[/img]

Through the Trading Post, trades with characters from distant settlements can now be conducted. Once the Trading Post is established, new traders will appear in the settlement at regular intervals. You can see which trader it will be and when they will arrive in the settlement in the trade window.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/3e46d8b41be1a24a9afc0af0601af82a3de611ad.png[/img]
[i]UI window of the Trading Post while a trader is on site and when a trade is conducted[/i]

Each merchant builds a relationship with your settlement based on the fairness of the completed trades and also has its own specialization. How fair a trade is is also shown in the window and can be varied by adjusting the individual goods. The better the relationship with a trader, the more likely he is to bring rare goods and the better the offers. In addition to common resources, seeds and research points can also be traded. The trading options will of course be expanded in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/2fe40e3aa1ec020e0bd8f3431747cb81fdf90cbe.gif[/img]
[i]Trade window with Rusty Rolph[/i]

Once a trade has been completed, logisticians must take the required goods to the trading post. If all goods are available, the trade is carried out, the balloon flies out of the trading post and leaves the settlement. A new research area also unlocks the possibility for the player to decide manually and freely which trader should appear next.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/5de9d99c11746e6ea57482a3b8405b544a8d1e27.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a94ce34d7af14c0fd559f5a5358e0325b771cc1b.png[/img]
[i][Rusty Rolph / Susan Melfi / Ole Sørensen / Old T. Bara / Lizzy Rasmus][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ef97d9dbe788796bb72f964111653cf428bfd88f.png[/img]
[i][Balloons in the shown order: Old T. Bara / Lizzy Rasmus / Susan Melfi / Ole Sørensen / Rusty Rolph][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/0f6d71b656b98718ca7290482a72a5da578dbcd9.gif[/img]

In the course of the revised educational system, we have discreetly changed the school, as it functioned up to now, and also added a secondary building. Up to now, a settlement of a good 100 children could be educated with a single school without any problems. The final result was that the school was built early and no further interaction was necessary. Through the new educational system, we now differentiate into four different areas, which can be learned through the School with focus on only one each:

[b][list][*]Settlers work more effectively
[*]Settlers use tools more carefully
[*]Settlers use clothes more carefully
[*]Badges can be obtained faster [/list][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4f7971542680f608851db3c67d7d99a8a6e6fd50.png[/img]
[i]UI window of the school. Only one area is taught at a time[/i]

The Advanced School also makes it possible to learn all areas at the same time. In addition, more students can be trained at the same time. If both the Advanced School  and the regular school are available, children always prioritize the better building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ad09dc7e569e3555642a8931cc08f2b11f88061d.png[/img]
[i]Advanced School in the settlement[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/46e669624d2309c250e9cabaf61d6f5a5245db26.gif[/img]
[i]UI window of the Advanced School. All areas are taught simultaneously [/i].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/297bbe692536747eab8ac1b92aa690dfbd62fab1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f7a2de8d76549340a61e26c93c7b96c4c80f73c9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[url=https://discord.com/invite/worldofendzone][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/857c6611858f47a4fa7b6b44aedbaf572b46ff1e.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/933820/announcements/detail/2910969711808371938][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f6535bf35155402120176bc84c86fffd142a727f.png[/img][/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4187c3d3bf6a1c2c0657a1fb77b77d7fdd5f168c.png[/img]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/933820/announcements/detail/2910969711808802005][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/7698a58f58bdb965bac65092dcd7f78cf9c2ac67.png[/img][/url]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1uhApROBzCg

We know that there are still some things we need to fix, and we are listening to your feedback. We try to address all important issues in a timely manner and make the game as a whole more understandable and fair. However, it is important to note that Endzone - A World Apart is a survival game. Challenging gameplay, as well as a difficult learning curve, are intended and are designed to provide the player with a difficult task.

[i]- Your team from Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment[/i]
