notes.title: Leadership Update - Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/6aeafc6a24c3514a634986531c24b569ccec9256.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]

With the [b]seventh update[/b] for [b]Endzone - A World Apart[/b], [b]decrees[/b] are finally being introduced that allow you to set a direction in your settlement. Through the newly introduced building, the [b]Forum[/b], you will gain access to a new UI, with which you can issue decrees. However, the issuing of decrees is always accompanied by a drawback and must therefore be used with caution. What can obviously help the progress of your settlement does not have to be seen as such by every settler. Dissatisfaction and lack of understanding can be consequences of issuing decrees. On the other hand many decrees are useful to save the settlement from destruction. Your task is to handle your power carefully and with foresight and to keep the settlement alive. The newly introduced Decree-System should give experienced players more control in the late game and help them expand even more while giving new players the option to prevent themselves from losing their settlement due to failure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added the “Forum” to Community Buildings. The player can enact decrees that have an effect on all settlers but always come with a drawback. Additionally the Forum allows settlers to post tasks to a Bulletin Board. The player can choose from a collection of tasks to decide which rewards he wants to follow.
[*][b]Decoration Buildings:[/b] Added new decoration buildings: Hedge, flower bed and a pioneer statue. The Pioneer Statue unlock by completing a specific task from the Bulletin Board in the Forum.
[*][b]Technologies:[/b] Added decrees to the technology tree.
[*][b]Field Seeds:[/b] Added 3 new types of seeds for fields: Carrots, Zucchini and Tomatoes.
[*][b]Scenarios:[/b] “Garden Eden” was added as a new scenario.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Added a collection of new side missions to the game.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] The tutorial has been enhanced to cover latest features.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Added an option to change the size of the default cursor.
[*][b]Sound:[/b] Added one new music track
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/96c0c116408ff5e59f671e6efb31cc28b823eb12.png[/img]
[i]New Seeds in the respective order.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9a1f5079bd81f637e4ed8ae8b286b383aaa77687.png[/img]
[i]New Decorations in the respective order.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Electricity:[/b] Buildings now consider the distance to their connection point when connecting to a power grid instead of the building’s center.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] The technology window no longer highlights a technology that was previously in research when the research station is demolished and build up again.
[*][b]Performance:[/b] Removed different performance leaks that occurred in the User Interface.
[*][b]Electricity Analytic View:[/b] The highlighting for power lines that are in construction no longer highlights the whole grid as “In construction”.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] A damaged building that is being demolished now says “Demolish next” instead of “Repair next” on its prioritization button.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] The inspector of buildings now updates correctly when being open while upgrading buildings.
[*][b]Loading Screen:[/b] The progress bar of the loading screen on startup now has its fill origin on top.
[*][b]Electricity:[/b] The Wind Turbine now displays its effect on surrounding buildings while being build.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Production Limits:[/b] Production limits have been raised by factor 10.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Improved all cursors and added new cursors to different situations in the game.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Construction sites now allow to change the Builder Mode in their inspector User Interface.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Added a warning to “Build Next”, “Repair Next” and “Demolish Next” buttons that shows up if the currently set builder mode prevents the construction or repair task from bein finished.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Added a hotkey and a visual indicator to switch through builder modes (Default: “G” on the keyboard).
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Added a hotkey and a visual indicator to enable highlighting of buildings of the same type while in build mode (Default: “H” on the keyboard).
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Slightly rearranged the top HUD of the game and added the current amount of knowledge points.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] The UI for Production recipes now shows the progress of the resource that will finish its production next.
[*][b]Irrigation Plant:[/b] The irrigation plant now allows it to choose from which water sources it should receive water.
[*][b]Environment:[/b] The environment is now animated while in the expedition window or while leading an expedition through a ruin, even if the game is paused.
[*][b]Refinery:[/b] Production recipes can now be activated/deactivated.
[*][b]Ruins:[/b] Tweaked the maximal spawn amount of several ruins to provide more variety on the map.
[*][b]Sound:[/b] Added or improved sounds for different buildings.
[*][b]Sound:[/b] Normalized the volume of most sounds.
[*][b]Research Station:[/b] The Research Station now only generates Knowledge up to a production limit that is set by the player. The maximum production limit for knowledge generation is 10 Knowledge, however the player can store more Knowledge if it is collected from side missions or expeditions.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/2c8cf6fa66b9cfa7986ec9c41f8493b14e90f52e.gif[/img]

With the help of decrees some processes in the settlement can be slowed down or even stopped completely. Decrees serve to regulate grievances, to lead prevention or to help with expansion. Each decree is provided with a drawback, so that during the execution it should always be considered whether the current malus is bearable. Decrees can be executed in the [b]Forum[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/6fade1d18c7651794f7d291551444bb2d84bd124.png[/img]

Decrees can be divided into immediate and permanent decrees. An immediate decree is executed immediately and can only be executed again after its cooldown has expired. The effect of a permanent decree will continue to affect the settlement until its cooldown has expired.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/d177512f7df877ea29c1224ae7311e2b1eee82e6.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f15cf1ee2d78d48590061d31a2cc9a52e5bf5539.png[/img]

[h2]Following decrees are available yet:[/h2]

[b]Birth Control[/b]
[i]This decree prohibits childbirths.[/i]

[b]Banish Elderly[/b]
[i]Old settlers are banished from the settlement. This lowers the confidence of the remaining settlers by <<amount>>.[/i]

[b]Banish Children[/b]
[i]Children are banned from the settlement. This lowers the confidence of the settlers by <<amount>>.[/i]

[b]Food Rationing[/b]
[i]Settlers may only consume <<percentage>> of their usual food. This lowers their confidence by <<amount>>.[/i]

[b]Water Rationing[/b]
[i]Settlers may only consume <<percentage>> of their usual water requirements. This lowers their confidence by <<amount>>.[/i]

[b]Incentive[/b]
[i]Settlers are encouraged to move faster than before <<percentage>>. This increases their food and water consumption by <<amount>>.[/i]

[b]Diligence[/b]
[i]All settlers increase the durability of their tools and clothing by <<percentage>>, but move slower.[/i]

[b]Immunity[/b]
[i]The settlers' consumption of herbs and medicine increases by <<amount>>. This prevents the outbreak of new diseases.[/i]

[b]Knowledge Transfer[/b]
[i]All uneducated adults are educated. This decree consumes <<amount>> knowledge accumulated at the research station.[/i]

[b]Prohibition of Funerals[/b]
[i]Graves of already buried settlers will be dissolved and all newly deceased settlers will be cremated for the duration of the decree, but not buried in a cemetery.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f47b15dd82e80e99083341c24c0f95fa54a59c90.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/1945438252187c29a9dbdfefee0d856283fc6640.png[/img]

The bulletin board now allows the player to manage missions much easier and not to miss important notifications. Once the forum is established, new missions are placed directly on the notice board and can be selected, rejected or accepted by the player at any time. A certain mission is even exclusively available on the bulletin board and unlocks the pioneer statue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/258789fe62096671bba67f65af26f2162629b2d6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4e247fa0270052eeea1a121c2881ff8974a31df5.gif[/img]

[h1]You spoke, we listened![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/aaf0840ab21f12282cf37ce16116471356e06492.png[/img]

notes.title: 1.971 Trees Planted in the Pacific Northwest!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings, survivors![/b][/h2]

In August, we sold [b]1.971 "Save the World"-Editions[/b] and we have decided to plant trees in the Pacific Northwest. Orcas are depending on a rich salmon population, so when they migrate North to South and back along the West Coast, they have enough food. However, salmon stocks are diminishing due to loss of habitat and increasing pollution - ultimately impacting the Orca downstream. Planting trees along rivers and streams of the Pacific Northwest restores habitat for the endangered orca. Trees help reduce pollution and improve the health and quantity of salmon for the orca to eat!

Thanks again to everyone who decide to buy the [b]"Save The World"-Edition[/b] to help us make the world a little greener, as we plant a real tree for each edition sold! In total we already planted [b]33.758[/b] trees around the world!

notes.title: A New Civilization Update | Available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/178a303acd35b8e0ae4254c3e970e114086e4bde.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]

With the sixth update for Endzone - A World Apart a couple of changes come into play. We have reworked a system that dates back to the Closed Beta and needed an overhaul. When implementing the [b]Confidence System[/b], we deliberately built in advantages and disadvantages early on, which should have a significant influence on the flow of the game and the player's decisions. With the previous system, this effect was unfortunately hardly noticeable, or expressed itself mainly through negative influences. The reworked system now brings much more depth and complements the Gameplay with meaningful and credible needs of the settlers and, of course, their reaction to fulfilling or not fulfilling them. We also aimed on making Endzone easier to observe and read. With two new [b]Heatmaps[/b], the created electricity network can be surveyed better, and the newly implemented attractiveness of the settlement can be tracked.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a2234f76715900e6ab8ba7f9f0ad4f4e5e26d067.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]With this Update, we enable the possibility of an Autosave. It is disabled by default, but can be  activated manually in the settings. You can also change the time interval, in which the Autosave saves your current game. [i]Right now the system can hold up to 5 automatically saved savegames per session. After reaching this number, older saves are automatically deleted.[/i][/b]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Added a new UI for Confidence and overhauled the confidence system. Confidence is now divided into 3 sections: Negative, Neutral, and Positive confidence. The Negative and Positive sections are further divided into 3 Tiers. Slipping into the negative confidence zone will cause riots in your settlement and people may start to leave. Being in the positive confidence zone will give you benefits such as special side missions.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Added a new Analytic View for Electricity. This view helps you to view and analyze your electricity network without having to click on individual buildings. It displays valid power line connections and highlights all power consumers and producers.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Added a new Analytic View for Attractiveness: Since buildings now have different Attractiveness values and your settlers react to them, it is important to have a clear overview on how buildings affect the attractiveness of your settlement and, therefore, your settlers’ confidence.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Added special notifications when a seed or a new technology has been unlocked. In addition, a new notification triggers when new settlers are joining your settlement.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Added a food variety indicator to show how many different food sources are available in the settlement. Having different food sources was always important for the health of the individual settler, but it was never really properly displayed.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Added Birth Control as part of the functionality unlocked when upgrading your town center to level 2. Birth Control will result in a negative confidence debuff, but also prevent any new births for a certain period of time.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added the kitchen which allows your settlers to produce processed food/meals and can help to withstand a food shortage.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Added 5 decorative buildings to the game that also contribute to the attractiveness of an area.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Added sound effects to all expeditions for better immersion. When making a decision for an expedition, there are sets of sound effects to complement your actions.
[*][b]Savegames:[/b] Added optional AutoSave functionality to the game. You can enable AutoSave and a timing interval in the Options menu.
[*][b]Achievements:[/b] Added 17 new achievements to the game.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Added 17 new side missions to the game.
[*][b]Music:[/b] Added 1 new music track to the game.
[*][b]Social Media:[/b] Added several social media icons in the main menu with direct links to Endzone.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Statistics:[/b] Temporary Storeroom and Warehouse are now contributing to statistics.
[*][b]Statistics:[/b] The UI of the statistics window now works better with different aspect ratios.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Orchards now correctly change their seed. Beware: trees are immediately chopped down when selecting a new seed, but you’ll also get some wood out of it.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed coal pile not marked as blocking during building placement.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed wind effect for the School.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed possible errors caused by the building system.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] The inspector for farms now shows “Hemp” instead of “Food” to signal that hemp is not a food resource.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Hemp is now correctly decontaminated in all storage buildings.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed possible error when a pub is among the possible visitable buildings.
[*][b]Settlers:[/b] Prevent error when a settler is living in a non existing house on startup.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] The tool requirement for one of the Endzone expeditions now increases the chance as expected.
[*][b]Expedition Post:[/b] Expedition Post now gives correct feedback when the production limit is reached or inventory is full.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Fixed several missing headlines for Side Missions.
[*][b]Feedback (Stomt):[/b] Fixed that shortcuts were still fired in the background, when the feedback popup was opened.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Electricity:[/b] Warehouses, Cisterns, Irrigation Plants, and the Weather Station no longer consume power. This was done since they did not have any gameplay related effects.
[*][b]Electricity:[/b] Settlers working at Gatherer’s Cabins, Herbal Huts, Forester Lodges, Scrapyards, and Hunting Lodges now work faster if their production building has power connected.
[*][b]Electricity:[/b] A Power Line now loses all connections if it is in a demolished state, making it clearer as to why a power grid might be malfunctioning. 
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] The "?"-button in building inspectors now shows the building tooltip instead of only title and description, so that all the info is right there.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Changed icons of some happiness buffs.
[*][b]Balancing:[/b] Tweaked balancing values for protective clothing and tools.
[*][b]Balancing:[/b] Doubled the wood cost for metal tools.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Created new visuals for the tailor building.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Changed visuals for the tank to be more immersive and fitting to the game’s story timeline.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Damaged buildings no longer show a large and clumsy UI in their inspector but are marked as “damaged” with a visual indicator on top. Additionally, the condition bar below the icon of the building now provides detailed information about the repair status in its tooltip.
[*][b]Glossary:[/b] Updated and added glossary entries for new and existing buildings.
[*][b]Research:[/b] Added the kitchen as a researchable technology.
[*][b]Performance:[/b] Ported entity tracing to a faster GPU solution.
[*][b]Sandstorm:[/b] Sandstorm no longer does percentile damage, so that hit points of buildings actually have an impact now.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Tweaked Overloaded mission, so it only triggers if there is no battery connected at all.
[*][b]UI:[/b] Goals that involve the production or storage of resources now indicate whether the production limit of that resource prevents the goal from being solved.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/cdb6491b7b3ed95d02e7fe2595c5ed4262962195.gif[/img]

With this update we have significantly revised the confidence system, so that there is now a clear added value in both positive and negative directions. Confidence was for a long time a value that should be kept in positive territory, but was difficult to bring into negative territory through the regular game flow. Mainly differences arose due to the death of a relative of a settler, which of course could not be averted. The system therefore offered only a small added value and was rather used or regarded as an accessory.
Through the refurbishment, Confidence is now a sensitive system, which is influenced by each individual settler in the settlement. Each settler has his own list of needs that can be met, not met or triggered. How happy an individual settler is now proportionally contributes to the overall [b]Confidence[/b] of the settlement. This means that an average is calculated, which can effect which missions or actions are triggered and can influence the behavior of the settlers in a negative way as well as in a positive way. The new [b]Confidence System[/b] is staggered in 3 sections, each consisting of 3 tiers which are in the negative, neutral and positive range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ea6d7ca2a04d1d960cd820b881a16cfec2f8d06a.png[/img]

This value is influenced by existing buildings, as well as food and events within the settlement. Confidence can fluctuate. The neutral area can be seen as a buffer zone in which the player has the possibility to protect himself from sliding into the negative area or to take effective steps to change into the positive area.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4d78670c0bec5656e910f5cf03a3e2e7622bf2ea.gif[/img]

A well-known problem in Endzone was the readability of the electricity network. Electricity poles are not easy to recognize in the turmoil and also the overview of the connected power line quickly left a lot to be desired in a larger settlement. With the new [b]Heatmap[/b] for electricity, buildings can now be distinguished more easily. Connections and consumption are also marked and can now be observed more easily. The change in readability, which was very positive for us, inspired us to introduce another [b]Heatmap[/b] to illustrate the [b]Attractiveness[/b]. In this view, the attractiveness of individual buildings is also shown very simply and schematically. It also shows how other buildings influence the status even before construction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/e29bb07609a038bc4f837711966d9b12674a9001.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/deec291da138e6dffc0452d74ab6cf8e1c869f6a.png[/img]
[i]Electricity Heatmap[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/0b13143e5b29ae2a02f54d9d540172d28a81c7c7.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/412fd3e2f757193704b672f63df1cb83649a7908.png[/img]
[i]Attractiveness Heatmap[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/27e99a8af46a836196ca81251842d0d3e710fb75.gif[/img]

This update has only added one building to the world of Endzone, but it was intended to help new players in particular. Also, the proposal has been submitted many times as feedback, so we were happy to follow up on the request. Oh, and we redesigned the Tailor for better visual feedback and a more suitable presentation:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/62e39f4b5d9b69134e74eeb2f88fde79c23e8513.png[/img]
[i]Tailor[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9cdef2829420b954301ddeb61e87923ce310238e.png[/img]
[i]Kitchen[/i]

The [b]Kitchen[/b] can be explored as a building and allows the player to increase the amount of valuable food for his settlement significantly by using a simple recipe. [b]10 units of food and 10 units of water can be processed in the kitchen to 100 units of food[/b]. It doesn't matter which food is used to create it. In addition, dishes that are produced in the kitchen are counted as variations in food and thus contribute to the diversity in the settlers' diet. Up to 5 cooks can work in the kitchen, but the amount of processed food does not increase proportionally from the fourth cook onwards, but increases slightly less.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/015547063a5fdb540df975d9bb7f610876ce326b.png[/img]
[i]Food Variety icon[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/3abfbb02398e13a3c200669b57f9616fcb2fd890.png[/img]
[i]Processed Food icon[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/5e278868c03354bba7c736a6a70fe734ecd1324a.gif[/img]

notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings, survivors![/b][/h2]

This time the total number of units sold has reached a number of [b]2.498[/b] and we have decided to plant trees in Uganda. This is especially to help the chimpanzees living there, who lost a major area of their natural habitat due to heavy clearing of the forest.
The trees will be planted in the Albertine Rift forests of Uganda, close to where Dr. Jane Goodall began her extraordinary career and fell in love with chimpanzees - our closest wildlife relatives.

Thanks again to everyone who decide to buy the [b]"Save The World"-Edition[/b] to help us make the world a little greener!

notes.title: Radiation Update | Available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/3287b88d464b332b539694882c385612961802ff.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]
[b]Saudações, sobreviventes![/b]
[b]¡Saludos, supervivientes![/b]

The fifth update for Endzone - A World Apart brings again two more buildings into play. The new additions are used to combat radiation. Previously, players repeatedly had problems with the growing radiation and also had difficulties protecting themselves against it. With the new changes and implementations it is now easier as long as you build a good infrastructure and invest some time in researching the new technologies. We also added two new languages and different keyboards layouts, and custom keybindings are now supported!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a2234f76715900e6ab8ba7f9f0ad4f4e5e26d067.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]With this update we are migrating to a new savegame system. [b]Your old savegame will not be compatible with this version.[/b] We hope that our new savegame system is more flexible and will no longer require us to break old savegame in the future. Also, you should notice slightly faster save and load times.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Controls:[/b] Players can now rebind all key mappings of the game based on their needs in the “Controls” menu found under “Options”.
[*][b]Localization:[/b] Added Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese.
[*][b]Localization:[/b] Added special characters for Turkish and Vietnamese language to font assets.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Replaced all settler avatars with new and improved ones, providing a larger variety of looks and distinct differences between ages of settlers.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] A Decontamination Post has been added. It allows the player to clean contaminated goods that are stored in a logistics building. This new building produces Decontamination Kits, which are distributed among the inventories of buildings within its work area and clean resources from contamination.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] A Mine has been added that allows you to mine coal or iodine from mountains. Both ways of mining have to be researched in the Research Station. Iodine can be used to create Iodine Tablets, an effective way to treat your settlers' radiation levels.
[*][b]Recipes:[/b] Added a new production recipe to the Medical Facility that allows to convert Iodine into Iodine Tablets. Iodine Tablets are consumed by settlers to free themselves from contamination. The production recipe is unlocked together with the Iodine Mining technology in the Research Station.
[*][b]Technology:[/b] Added the technology “Mining Tunnel Construction”. Researching this technology heavily reduces the negative effect on the efficiency of mines that are placed close to each other.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Added 8 new side missions.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Added 4 new expeditions.
[*][b]Graphic Options:[/b] Added settings to set the visual quality of objects.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Added new ruins to the game.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Added animations to some existing and new buildings.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Added destruction effects to all ruins, when they are destroyed.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Buildings of the same type are now highlighted during Build Mode. This effect can be toggled on or off in the game options in the Main Menu or using a shortcut on the keyboard (default key: ‘H’).
[*][b]Technology:[/b] Added a maximum amount for Research Points. This is also reflected in the UI.
[*][b]Glossary:[/b] Added new Glossary entries for the Decontamination Post, Iodine and Iodine Tablets.
[*][b]Savegames:[/b] We added a completely new savegame system. This system speeds up saving and loading files significantly.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/8a87b169b551300506f52190f42a36c69ff9d3d6.png[/img]
[i]Some of the new settler avatars (16 in total with numerous variations)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/c0dfa0681c1caa5ca0c610a0e3705ac13290edf4.png[/img]
[i]The new Highlighting shows related buildings in a blue overlay[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Engine Update:[/b] Updated our engine version from Unity 2019.2 to 2019.4 LTS. Being on this new version includes numerous bug fixes by our engine vendor. It also allows us to benefit from upcoming bug fixes in the future.
[*][b]Savegames:[/b] The new system fixes wrong and spontaneous erratic behavior that could lead to broken or corrupted savegames.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Assigning workforce to a profession using right click now assigns all remaining free settlers if the maximum possible amount is higher than the amount of free settlers.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Advantages on Expeditions that require all settlers to apply to them are now highlighted correctly during the configuration of an expedition.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Fixed several occurrences where buttons in the options of a building where wrongly hidden.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Fixed an error that occurred when entering a share code without “#”.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] The share code input field now allows the correct number of characters.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Position Markers on the minimap from previous session no longer consist in new sessions.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Settlers now look into the direction of their task (e.g. when cutting down trees) to improve animation authenticity.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Settlers should not have holes in their 3D representation anymore.
[*][b]Gameplay:[/b] Resource piles will no longer be automatically transported to storage buildings but rather used if settlers require resources from them.
[*][b]Gameplay:[/b] “Schroedinger’s Settlers” have been fixed. Demolishing a house and cancelling the demolition immediately could lead to “invisible” settlers. This has now been fixed.
[*][b]Side Missions:[/b] Side Missions no longer throw an error if the Glossary was opened beforehand.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Fixed some wrongly locked or unlocked buildings.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] Market quest now rewards coal masks.
[*][b]Performance:[/b] Several performance optimizations to avoid stuttering.
[*][b]Startup:[/b] When the game was opened for the first time it was possible to be stuck in a black screen when no button was pressed. This is now fixed.
[*][b]Buildings:[/b] Settlers who walk to scrap piles or the Scrap Catcher now use correct paths which are not wrongly offset anymore.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] A ruin with several story threads never spawned the last one. This has been fixed now.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Gameplay:[/b] Children in Sturdy Houses are born faster now. This prevents the issue that less children were born when upgrading to this house type.
[*][b]Controls:[/b] Players with non QWERTY keyboards (e.g. AZERTY) can now play the game with the correct key mappings.
[*][b]Gameplay:[/b] Settlers will now always use the nearest building that has a resource available instead of following a strict priority queue.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Nights are now brighter.
[*][b]Visuals:[/b] Changed the model for the derelict tank and removed the WW2 version that did not fit with the game's timeline.
[*][b]Balancing:[/b] Settlers are now noticeably affected by contaminated water and food.
[*][b]Balancing:[/b] Tweaked the work times of Tailors and Technicians to improve the output of tools and clothing.
[*][b]Balancing:[/b] Increased the respawn time of wildlife.
[*][b]Balancing:[/b] Minor balancing changes to some Side Missions.
[*][b]Balancing:[/b] Researchers have a much larger inventory now, so they are able to supply resources for new technologies much faster.
[*][b]Market:[/b] Markets now also accept refined resources like Metal or Electronics.
[*][b]Tutorial:[/b] The tutorial has been slightly adjusted to introduce some of the new buildings and features.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Assigning professionals in the inspector of a building now also allows you to right click the increase button in order to assign the maximum amount.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] The production limit interface in the Refinery has been reworked to avoid that increase and decrease production limit areas are misleading due to their position in the UI.
[*][b]Building Placement:[/b] It is now possible to place buildings on parking lot ruins.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Fields now show “Food” as a production limit instead of individual resources.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] Production Limits in the Production Limit Menu now update correctly if a production limit is changed in the inspector of a building.
[*][b]User Interface:[/b] The tooltip, when hovering over a building in the build menu now shows the number of buildings of this type.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Several Expeditions now unlock Iodine Tablets as a reward. Iodine Tablets can be used by settlers to treat their individual radiation levels.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Added checkmarks for expeditions when progress is at 100%.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Added Iodine Tablets to some Expeditions as a reward.
[*][b]Expeditions:[/b] Added a new option to the Nuclear Power Plant Expedition that allows you to go back one step.
[*][b]Resources:[/b] Local piles will no longer be auto transported to storages. Instead they act like mini storages and your settlers take goods only when needed. The resources of these piles will now directly contribute to your global inventory.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/8684e9cadf1eb8bb967d23841890d42e94844b4e.png[/img]
[i]Comparison of the brightness in the new patch vs. the old status[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ec24c6b5efe3d99ce3ed2c8ca69509be7727a983.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Gameplay:[/b] The tooltip for a Sturdy House is not describing that children are now born twice as fast.
[*][b]Plantations:[/b] Changing a seed on a plantation is currently bugged and nearly impossible, because Plantations are rarely completely harvested. To change a seed you need to tear down the plantation. We are already working on a fix for that.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/27e99a8af46a836196ca81251842d0d3e710fb75.gif[/img]

[h2]Decontamination Post[/h2]

The [b]Decontamination Post[/b] is the place where [b]Decontamination Kits[/b] are produced by the new profession [b]"Decontaminator"[/b], with which already contaminated food can be cleaned again. Any building with an inventory can receive the kits and thus remove the radiation. Note, however, that while [b]Cultivated Fields[/b] and [b]Orchards[/b] can hold food in their inventory, they do not count as buildings. That's why you should always supply a dedicated [b]Warehouse[/b] with [b]Decontamination Kits[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/028b1b9522595768b0b1851a332452cc63d5f8f4.png[/img]

[h2]Mine[/h2]

A [b]Mine[/b] can be built directly on mountains. Research unlocks the branches [b]"Coal"[/b] and [b]"Iodine"[/b], which can only be mined individually in a single [b]Mine[/b].
[b]Iodine[/b] can be used in a [b]Medical Facility[/b] to produce [b]Iodine Tablets[/b], which settlers can use to reduce their existing radiation. Settlers can even become fertile again if the radiation is completely removed using [b]Iodine Tablets[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/8612ec865b05fc183a74afd7f231e611fd148ebb.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/297bbe692536747eab8ac1b92aa690dfbd62fab1.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/56577fbfa01f222a72b75998eee142bef988a96b.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=QdbNkgqsLoY;full][/previewyoutube]

[url=https://discord.gg/HF7SaH7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a1fb23da4f8837100258611e6cd889668cc9f464.png[/img][/url]


[i][b]We know that there are a few more things we need to address and we are listening to your feedback. We're trying to address all the important issues in a timely manner and make the game as a whole more understandable and fair. However, it is important to remember that Endzone - A World Apart is a survival game, so we have made it challenging with full intention.[/b][/i]

[i]- Your Team von Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment[/i]

notes.title: Technology Update Patch #1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/5abae351c4b797b781f0fdeb5a7f776f07d0f676.gif[/img]

Greetings, survivors!

As we noticed that with the last update some things had to be fixed or changed after all, we now release a small patch. We hope that the changes will also solve some subsequent errors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Audio:[/b] Added options for the audio feedback on settler deaths to the audio game options. Players can now decide whether they want to have audio feedback on unnatural deaths or all deaths or turn it off completely. Additionally players can set a delay that defines the amount of deaths before the audio feedback is played again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] Fixed a Bug where professionals wouldn’t carry the amount of resources they were supposed too (e.g. when transporting boar meat from the dead animal to their Hunting Lodge).
[*] [b]Research:[/b] Research Station now only generates knowledge when it’s supposed to.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed a Bug where dead settlers were stuck in buildings.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] The technology window and the inspector of the Research Station now update correctly when research was interrupted and a new one was started.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Using the back button during Expeditions now selects the correct Dialog Option when entering the previous Option Group.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Share codes now follow a new format and include research and rain director game settings. Old Share Codes will no longer work. Future changes to the share code however should no longer break.
[*] [b]User Interface: [/b]The inventory dialog at ruins during expeditions no longer shows resources that have an amount of zero.
[*] [b]Visuals:[/b] Building emission maps are now only active at night when electricity is available.
[*] [b]Fields:[/b] Hemp Fields now use the Production Limit for Hemp instead of Food.[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Balancing:[/b] The sturdy house now inhabits 4 Adults and 6 children to prevent a complete stop of population growth.

[*] [b]Roads:[/b] Dirt Roads and Paved Roads are now highlighted differently while in Build Mode.
[*] [b]Town Center:[/b] The initial stage and first upgrade of the Town Center now have increased storage capacities.
[/list]

[b]We know that there are a few more things we need to address and we are listening to your feedback. We're trying to address all the important issues in a timely manner and make the game as a whole more understandable and fair. However, it is important to remember that Endzone - A World Apart is a survival game, so we have made it challenging with full intention.[/b]

[i]- Your Team von Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment[/i]

notes.title: Technology Update | Available now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/5abae351c4b797b781f0fdeb5a7f776f07d0f676.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]

After the first Updates that mainly involved Balancing and introducing long time planned mechanics, we are now introducing the Technology Tree and the associated [b]Research Station[/b], bringing research to the world of Endzone while adding several new buildings based on your feedback. We also added 2 new Scenarios, 5 new Side Missions and 6 new Expeditions. Additionally, another major aspect was the adjustment of the erratic and inefficient behavior of the builder profession. Builders now act way smarter and help you build exactly the city that you want to have. We sure also did take our time to iron out bugs and issues players reported over the month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a2234f76715900e6ab8ba7f9f0ad4f4e5e26d067.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] We made profound changes to settler behavior and especially the [b]Builder profession[/b]. Builders will now exclusively deliver resources to constructions sites. Please see the Tweaked section for in-depth info.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added a small and medium version of the [b]Warehouse[/b] that can be upgraded into a large [b]Warehouse[/b]. Each upgrade has more capacity.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added a [b]Hemp Weaving Mill[/b] that produces Cloth from Hemp.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added a [b]Wind Turbine[/b] that constantly produces power but can only supply a small number of buildings. The [b]Wind Turbine[/b] is also the first building that uses building animations.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added A [b]Scrap Catcher[/b] that is able to catch scrap whirling around during sandstorms.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added a [b]Research Station[/b] that enables the player to research new buildings, formulas or other technologies. Accumulate [b]Knowledge[/b] by performing expeditions, solving certain [b]Side Missions[/b] or by assigning [b]Researchers[/b]. New buildings can be unlocked in the Technology Tree.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] The [b]Shelter[/b] can now be upgraded into an upgraded [b]Shelter[/b].
[*] [b]Feature:[/b] Added a Technology Tree that the player can use to perform research. The Technology Tree is only a first version and will be enhanced in future updates.
[*] [b]Content:[/b] 6 new [b]Expeditions[/b] were added.
[*] [b]Content:[/b] 2 new [b]Scenarios[/b] were added.
[*] [b]Content:[/b] 6 new [b]Side Missions[/b] were added.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Added color schemes for radiation and water levels that can be selected in the Game Options Menu to assist with color blindness (let us know other color combinations, so we can add them as an option)
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Added Glossary Entries to all new buildings
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Added descriptions to Scenario Medals that roughly describe what to do to reach a medal
[*] [b]Achievements:[/b] Added 2 new Achievements for both new scenarios.
[*] [b]Game Options:[/b] Added new Game Options for Research and Rain Contamination Director. The Research Game Options include a ‘Legacy’ option that unlocks all buildings that were available to the player before this update from the start.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/aa4c3ee5647cbd66be5e4d480faeb270d7ad78f9.png[/img]
[i]- Different color schemes for colour-blind people -[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/bfc1e3d812fff1164ff40a8c7127d2db5a0f0016.gif[/img]
[i]- Radiation Heatmap switching through an alternative color scheme -[/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Performance:[/b] Opening the [b]Survival Handbook[/b] will no longer result in freezing the game for a few seconds.
[*] [b]Audio:[/b] Typewriter sound effect in settler dialog is now stopped when the window is closed before it finished
[*] [b]Audio:[/b] Fixed volume spike at the start of the game.
[*] [b]Audio:[/b] Click sound spamming of buildings and dialogues is now prevented.
[*] [b]Graphics:[/b] Fixed object clipping/popping when zooming in/out for the first time.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Fixed Minimap Position Markers on minimap resizing.
[*] [b]Save Games:[/b] Fixed housing logic for old save games
[*] [b]Save Games:[/b] Fixed circular tasks for old savegames
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Story Dialog now shows correct titles for already solved options
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] Effects when declining a Side Mission are now correctly triggered
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed settlers standing in front of the medical facility when they are ill.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed mipmapping for potatoes.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] [b]Irrigation Plant[/b] no longer stores infinite amounts of water when irrigation is set to “None”.
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] Several fixes to the task system.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Fixed wrongly colorized building grid and highlighting of streets.
[*] [b]Pathfinding:[/b] Fixed error when upgrading buildings.
[*] [b]Effects:[/b] Effects are now correctly rotated on rotated buildings/ruins.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] Improved the overall settler behaviour, primarily focussing on the profession “Builder”, as they were causing most of the trouble in your settlements. Builders should now work more efficiently regarding the construction of buildings. They will no longer change home with other settlers living near a construction site, which should boost the overall efficiency of your settlement. Builders will now also be responsible to deliver all resources needed for the construction of a building themselves, without the help of normal Settlers. Normal Settlers will only help to clear the construction site from trees or scrap and to dig up the ground in order to remove radiation.
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] If Game Options have droughts to be Always enabled, the game will start with zero ground humidity
[*] [b]Audio:[/b] Death sound now only plays on unnatural deaths. When a settler dies of natural causes (old age), the death sound is not played anymore.
[*] [b]Camera:[/b] Added small camera effect to main menu
[*] [b]Performance:[/b] Optimized rendering performance for all objects rendered by the camera.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Reworked parts of the main menu (e.g. the scenario menu) to give a better overall user experience and to work better with different display aspect ratios.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Added a UI element to show the fill level of all water specific buildings, including  Irrigation Plants, Cisterns, Water Towers, Wells and Rain Collectors.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Added better tooltips regarding disease spawning
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] New save games will now also create a screenshot that is saved and displayed in the load menu.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] The intro can now be played at any time from the ‘Extras’ section in the Main Menu.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] The intro will only play on the first start of the game, instead of every time the game boots up.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Toggling between buildings of the same type using the arrows in the building’s inspector now shows the index of the current building as well as the number of buildings of this type.
[*] [b]User Interface:[/b] Added camera movement that reacts to the mouse cursor in the main menu.
[*] [b]Balancing:[/b] A sturdy house now has space for up to 6 adults and 4 children.
[*] [b]Gameplay:[/b] Some buildings from former versions of the game are now part of the new technology tree.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added spot lights that illuminate buildings and their surroundings, when they are connected to electricity.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added light to well that will be activated when it is connected to electricity.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Iterated over all buildings and added smoke effect to all chimneys
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Changed visuals for the Wheat Seed
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Changed visuals for the Cultivated Field 
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Changed visuals for the Dirt Road
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fields will now always be harvested 100% once harvesting starts. This fixes cases where fields might have 1-2 seeds left that will never grow and therefore block the whole field.
[*] [b]Bug Overlay:[/b] The “Oopsie” error window now has a button that directly opens an explorer window, so you can find the relevant files more easily.
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] Settlers now have a random max age.
[*] [b]Gamedata:[/b] Migrated global progress save data from Config folder to the Save Game folder so it can be saved by any Cloud providers.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/e8d777ba7b74b309bd9d615fb56985712fd30fe9.gif[/img]
[i]- New volumetric lighting for buildings powered with electricity -[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ec24c6b5efe3d99ce3ed2c8ca69509be7727a983.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] [b]World Tasks:[/b] World Tasks that collect more than one resource type are currently ignoring max caps at the moment. When using a World Task like gathering forest plants, which can be berries, mushrooms and herbs for example, the maximum cap for two of these resource types is ignored.
[*] [b]Share Codes:[/b] Map Share Codes currently don’t affect the new game options “Research” and “Rain Contamination Director”.
[*] [b]Scrap Catcher:[/b] The point where Salvagers pickup scrap from the Scrap Catcher is currently wrongfully offset.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/27e99a8af46a836196ca81251842d0d3e710fb75.gif[/img]

Since the very first day of Early Access, people have constantly shared their ideas and plans for new buildings that could be part of the world of Endzone.
We discussed a lot, which buildings should find their way into the game based on the feedback and the necessity. Having the ability to conduct research and being able to use a Technology Tree for further advancements in the game, was an often called wish from you. Remember that this Update is only one of more Content Updates to follow. We are always collecting new ideas and listening to your feedback carefully.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/72d8ef873a308c7e98b5b30d95d9062c5ebfeaae.gif[/img]

The Research Station is the central building for research in Endzone. Through the [b]Research Station[/b] and the new profession "Researcher" you can now generate Knowledge Points. These can also be gained through expeditions or by completing side missions.
As soon as enough knowledge has been gathered, a new building can be explored via the Technology Tree. This process takes a while and costs resources. You also need your “Researches” for conducting research.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/babe29476d4c9b0a0d5597910a0a9bae203d0c3a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a316d1dcf93362df17c5ee6c5e92c78600e84b9f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/dccda93a011c2c973cb9c5a8aad704eed4eb606c.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/04cc1b666496cb3e551981a239c9fb61f4919e46.gif[/img]

The Scrap Catcher now gives you the chance to collect Scrap in your immediate surroundings. Emerging into the endgame your settlers were often forced to travel long distances in order to gather more scrap. The Scrap Catcher automatically catches Scrap It even catches more during Sandstorms. This mechanic makes Scrap now also an endless resource.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ea6643c008a9695c0711efc64a219c8eb0d69789.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/13ba40bcd95dd7b330ee1d7df53aec7c1f046368.gif[/img]

The Hemp Weaving Mill allows you to make cloth out of Hemp. Before it was only possible to generate Cloth from Scrap. This gives you another option to maintain the need for protective clothing from larger populations, without the need of Scrap.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/8fa72d31d1c3acbeb118c43b176884a6f6ec9355.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/5bfe4d9d5affa5bb2f660d61265f4a1e9d7c8290.gif[/img]

The new Shelter Upgrade can hold more people while taking up the same space as the old Shelter. You can now fit 50 people into the Shelter giving you better options to extend your population without spamming new buildings too much. The new Shelter also benefits from being connected to the power grid giving a bonus on the overall confidence of your settlers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/0a1e819e3808e22ecd03a5f0bb8421ce64682653.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/3b6ce72445589efb422e9beb01d9dbfe457fc437.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ae207c62d3fba1c979a2fcfa3d6810299820c4a7.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ff69fe001cc0662764bb1d7bec5027333f385a9f.gif[/img]

We had a lot of feedback regarding insufficient storage space, thus forcing the player to spam Warehouses to maintain the heavy need from a large population. The Temporary Storeroom is now the first building to build to increase your storage. It has the same storage capacity as the Warehouse before, therefore not changing the feel for the Early Game at all. With the two additional upgrades you get 10.000 or even 15.000 units of storage space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/e42b4e764c453c4720b349aa7355f7143339822a.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/c51575dae6d7e5dde920dee901a2a6d9fb5292ba.gif[/img]

We also introduced a new road type, the Paved Road. It gives you a significant speed bonus on the Movement Speed of your settlers. We also overhauled the visuals for the old road type (Dirt Road) to make them more distinguishable. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/1f5f1201e50c07ca8ec52460512274110adc1cb9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a57a6f28b0bdba29277a913661645b85cb9ac78a.gif[/img]

The Wind Turbine is a new electricity building, giving you a constant delivery of power for a small amount of buildings. The Wind Turbine can generate electricity all by itself, even at night and has no need to be connected to a Battery. The building itself can provide a lot less electricity than a Solar Collector, but can also be built with a lot less resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/479b4a4d19b2056c5977f17a9255b5b0f015c5ba.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/f6e5f8a7ce04fa271f7d499387e642e8463595da.gif[/img]

Builders and construction sites have been a topic since the very first day of Endzone. It constantly appeared, that builders did not prioritize buildings as they should, or better said as the player thought they would. This quickly could lead to a downward spiral of your settlement, since crucial buildings just were not built anymore, important steps or planning ahead did not work out at some point and drove the settlement into the abyss. Builders are now responsible for transporting resources to the construction site and will immediately take care of the construction. The "Build Next" button now works as you would expect. Immediately after pressing it, current orders will be cancelled and the construction of the building will take first priority. Builders also don’t change homes as quickly as before and will stay in their building profession.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/297bbe692536747eab8ac1b92aa690dfbd62fab1.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/e859e32ca2a696210098775734a675266afd44d1.jpg[/img]


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0laZ5T-6x60

[url=https://discord.gg/HF7SaH7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a1fb23da4f8837100258611e6cd889668cc9f464.png[/img][/url]

[i][b]We know that there are a few more things we need to address and we are listening to your feedback. We're trying to address all the important issues in a timely manner and make the game as a whole more understandable and fair. However, it is important to remember that Endzone - A World Apart is a survival game, so we have made it challenging with full intention.[/b][/i]

[i]- Your Team von Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment[/i]

notes.title: Content Update Teaser
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a8c45622bbb4f18f3911e96966ac2c3702074708.png[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]

It's a bit early to give too many details about the next patch, but we can already make some statements and talk a bit about the upcoming content.
The upcoming update will include a number of new content and buildings for the first time. We are also expanding existing systems like the [b]Scenarios[/b], [b]Side Missions[/b] and [b]Expeditions[/b] to bring more variety into the game.

Even though the focus this time was on new content for the game, we continued to listen to your feedback and made some adjustments to make the game feel more enjoyable and optimized based on things you told us or had discussions about with us. Of course, a number of bugs have also been fixed and other issues have been resolved.

[h2]Additional Buildings and Upgrades[/h2]

Although we have already talked about the new buildings that will find their way into the Endzone in the last stream, we reserve the surprise for ourselves and don't reveal too much. A total of [b]7 new buildings[/b] will be integrated and the game will be expanded with a new mechanic, among other things. Down below you find a teaser of a new building. Do you have an idea what it could be and how it works?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ccda998d61f88164a9fc64b37c7d5c5f3604ed5d.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/7ea6f2136f98afce067c991fb0e89983405ebd75.jpg[/img]

[h2]Additional Side Missions, Scenarios & Expeditions[/h2]

Of course we also want to expand existing systems continuously. For this update we plan to add a handful of [b]new missions[/b], a few [b]new scenarios[/b] and [b]new stories[/b] for the expeditions. 
Some of the existing ruins will now be properly integrated into the game and can be played like existing story ruins.

[h2]Settler Behavior[/h2]

Another major aspect of the new update will be the [b]behavior of the settlers[/b]. Currently, it feels like the player has little control over the build order and the amount of time a build order can take.
This leads not only to confusion for new players, but also to frustration for veterans who are familiar with indiscriminate action.
In the upcoming update, settlers will only be used for orders and the removal of building areas [b]Builders[/b] will now independently transport resources to the construction site and start building as soon as all resources are available. In this context the [b]"Build Next"[/b] button now also works much more reliably. This means, however, that many more [b]builders[/b] must actually be present in the profession to complete all orders reliably. [b]Free settlers[/b] now have less influence and therefore do not interfere with the game anymore, but work as intended as a backup or automatic exchange when a settler dies.

[b][i]For more information about the game, join our official Endzone - A World Apart Discord Server![/i][/b]

[i]- Your Team from Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment -[/i]

notes.title: Scenarios Update | Available now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/3d173380417e2a5c96fc4b67c1d0a54935adc7a7.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]

Another month has passed and the next big update has made it into the world of Endzone. This time we have worked hard to make the game more accessible to everyone. As part of this, we've added new game options that allow you to customize each new round as you wish. In addition to the familiar start condition settings, there are now far more sophisticated and extensive settings available.

In addition, we present you scenarios that represent a new game mode besides the endless game. Scenarios provide you with new challenges and define clear game objectives that have to be met. In addition, you will be rewarded with badges if you pass the individual tasks.

With this update, we also provide you with the statistics window, which will help you to better analyse your settlement and gain a new level of control.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a2234f76715900e6ab8ba7f9f0ad4f4e5e26d067.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Statistics[/b]: The new Statistics Screen will in some cases not show correct data and needs to collect new data if a save game from an older version of the game is loaded.
[*][b]Share Codes[/b]: Old Share Codes for Map Settings are no longer valid.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Scenarios[/b]: Added 5 scenarios to the game. Scenarios are challenging winning conditions under which you can play/beat the game. Every scenario has three completion levels and you can earn medals while progressing. Scenarios can also completely alter the way you have to approach and play the game. In the “long summer” scenario, for example, you have to survive long drought periods, making stockpiling food & water and buildings like the Irrigation Plant much more important.
[*][b]Game Options[/b]: Added many different game options to adjust and fine tune your gaming experience. With these options you can adjust the overall difficulty and playstyle.
[*][b]Game Options[/b]: Added game option presets so you don’t have to manually adjust all the different options by hand every time. The presets include “Easy Mode”, “Builder Mode” or even “Hard Mode” if you are looking for a challenging experience.
[*][b]Achievements[/b]: Added new achievements for beating all the different scenarios.
[*][b]Statistics[/b]: A completely new statistics screen has been added that provides detailed graphs about Production and Storage of Resources, Population and Buildings (See Important Notes).
[*][b]Main Menu[/b]: A Scenario Selection Menu has been added to the Main Menu
[*][b]Side Missions[/b]: Added 2 new Outlander Side Missions (you need to upgrade your Town Center twice to get Outlander missions)
[*][b]Tutorial[/b]: Added voice overs to the tutorial in German and English
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Upgrades[/b]: Fixed a bug when canceling the demolition of a building that should be upgraded
[*][b]Tutorial[/b]: Fixed cemetery link in tutorial
[*][b]Localization[/b]: Many proofreading fixes for german localization.
[*][b]Savegames[/b]: Day Time Range is no longer part of a savegame. This should fix possible problems where the game was stuck in night or day mode.
[*][b]Savegames[/b]: Fixed older savegames, which were broken due to new resource category.
[*][b]Settlers[/b]: Fixed bug for manual profession distribution on 300+ Settlers.
[*][b]Settlers[/b]: The profession list can now be scrolled correctly and is no longer blocked by headlines
[*][b]Electricity[/b]: Fixing Power Poles not being connected, although the preview showed this
[*][b]Electricity[/b]: Fixed Weather Station electricity tab not closing correctly
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Main Menu[/b]: Changed the structure when starting a new session in the game menu.
[*][b]Side Missions[/b]: Tweaked several Side Missions and removed building goals where possible, so you are not forced to place buildings
[*][b]Forester Lodge[/b]: Foresters now immediately plant a new tree after cutting a tree down, if replanting is enabled.
[*] Balancing: Changed preset maximum production amount of various resources (protective clothing, Hemp, Weed, Liquor, Ale, expedition rations)
[*][b]Balancing[/b]: Tweaked growth times and crop output of field and plantation seeds
[*][b]Balancing[/b]: Berries and mushrooms now spawn more food
[*][b]Buildings[/b]: Tweaked pathways for the Pub
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ec24c6b5efe3d99ce3ed2c8ca69509be7727a983.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Localization[/b]: Some parts of the new statistics screen and the main menu are auto translated.
[*][b]Statistics[/b]: Pie Charts and Bar Charts in the Dashboard on the left side of the new Statistics Screen are sporadically flickering when changing between windows.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a52ce2c5fef4a83a841b8a49e335e2227b3a22bd.gif[/img]

Scenarios represent a new game mode for Endzone. In addition to the endless game, you can now face concrete and challenging game goals. The individual scenarios can also fundamentally change the way you play. In the "Long Summer" scenario, for example, you have to survive very long periods of drought and have to think hard about how to store enough water and food supplies to be able to withstand the drought. However, scenarios can be adjusted so that you can play with the difficulty you feel most comfortable with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a8fa854e3f4d71053cc1103ba6583529ae2ad581.gif[/img]
[i][Starting a new game][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/7221f07f723807b16ae75cf23cc7996eda8fdde4.png[/img]
[i][Menu for choosing a new Scenario][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/886dc606e979172280fa5a9f966db0ef44d7c7b1.jpg[/img]
[i][New Steam Achievements][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/c41ebe75ac128b307333929d09df3e48676d5c15.gif[/img]

Many of you have expressed the wish to have more control over the flow of the game and the difficulty level. Especially at the beginning you would like to get to know the basic features of Endzone. But later on, as a veteran, you'll be looking for a really crisp challenge. With the extended game options we now give you the possibility to adjust many parameters of the game yourself and thus to fine-tune it. Even exotic combinations, such as a game without trees (you have to plant them first) can be adjusted in this way. In order to avoid having to adjust all the parameters by hand every time, there are additional presets that allow you to choose between different game types and challenges with a single click.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/23d36e7604719a15fa212e3cdf3e72beca616c58.png[/img]
[i][Overview of the possible Game Options that can manually be adjusted for every session][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/456c4e88f61bb93aeca0bedf896f40a49ec7ef7a.gif[/img]
[i][Comparison of different settings regarding the space around the starting area][/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/939e7817c0fcead0281cd34cda037ac52b34bb4c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/a09ab4da78a58f4b30c2de4c34aca28a6009a4ee.png[/img]
[i][Game Options setting "No Rain" and "Only Droughts"][/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/0d542a3c5b995c3866d0c87a80869de4d3f39f88.gif[/img]

You also wanted an extensive statistics view to analyze your settlement and get a better overview. Here we now provide you with views divided into different categories, which allow you to see exactly how your production buildings are performing and which grievances are currently in progress. Events such as droughts and sandstorms are also recorded directly in the graphs, so you can see which external influences have led to a decrease or increase. The new statistics are a first draft and will be expanded throughout the Early Access phase. We are therefore happy to receive ideas and suggestions for further graphs that you would find useful.

notes.title: Side Missions Update | Available Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/995f7fd10cb9a4a28e23b786d33a625f75c7da39.gif[/img]

[b]Greetings, survivors![/b]

[i]For the first Update in May we are finalizing our milestones from April and mark the first month as "Done". We added a little bit more than initially planned, since a lot of you reported various aspects that we found to be important and should be implemented together with the Side Missions. Now, we have also updated the Roadmap to show which contents are planned for June and already started to work on features for May.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/358f4e218820d14ba28920be33e1bc1eab7201e5.gif[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Side Missions[/b]: Added 17 new Side Missions[list][*]Missions can feature many different rewards and goals
[*]Missions can scale with your settlement
[/list]
[*][b]Side Missions[/b]: Added an additional Town Center upgrade[list][*]This allows you to intercept radio transmissions from other settlers that may want to join your camp
[/list]
[*][b]Tutorial[/b]:[list][*]Added a new, comprehensive Tutorial with over 30 quests
[*]Much more detailed steps
[*]Building Highlights
[*] Unlock buildings on the way
[/list]
[*][b]Expeditions[/b]: Added a filtering system to the [b]Expedition Window[/b], so it is easier to find the right settlers for your expedition
[*][b]Localization[/b]: Added [b]French[/b] to supported languages
[*][b]Main Menu[/b]: Added Extras section and “Game” Options, this includes a credits roll as well as the option to disable the intro video playback at the start of the game.
[*][b]Achievements[/b]: Added a new achievement for finishing the new tutorial.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed a bug with production buildings, where produced goods were not correctly transported anymore
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] The [b]Medical Facility[/b] now shows its efficiency when selected.
[*] [b]Building:[/b] The [b]Medicine[/b]n produced by the [b]Medical Facility[/b] is now listed under 'Produced' in the statistics.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Added production group to [b]Medical Facility[/b]
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] [b]Pubs[/b] can now be connected to [b]Power Grids[/b]
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed an error if a building gets dismantled during an upgrade
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] [b]Irrigation Plants[/b] no longer affect lakes
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Upgrading a building now correctly modifies the global inventory max weights
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] All buildings of category "Water" now add to the max water capacity of global inventory as [b]Rain Collectors[/b] and wells now also modify the global inventory
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Water that is stored in the [b]Town Center[/b] is now subtracted from the global inventory fill rate
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Fixed possible error when placing forester lodge at edge of map
[*] [b]Resources:[/b] Resource amounts are not longer added to produced statistics if the resource is added to the town center inventory
[*] [b]Resources:[/b] Awards from completing a [b]Side Mission[/b] are now added to the statistics under "produced"
[*] [b]Resources:[/b] Fixed global inventory to be at 100% way too early. Storage weight is now saved separately.
[*] [b]Resources:[/b] Fixed settler not equipping [b]Radiation Protection[/b] if protection is set to “None” in starting conditions.
[*] [b]Plantations[/b]: Fixed wrong textures for [b]Cherry trees[/b]
[*] [b]Plantations[/b]: are no longer completely cut down when you click on "Harvest now”
[*] [b]Settlers[/b]: Settlers do now correctly get a buff on their confidence when having a child
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] Settlers now correctly pick up [b]Neckscarfs[/b], [b]Activated Coal Masks[/b] and [b]Radiation Suits[/b] when the player has enabled filters in the [b]Town Center[/b]
[*] [b]Expeditions:[/b] Fixed ruins not being available to scout after cancelling an expedition
[*] [b]Environment:[/b] Amount of [b]Wildlife[/b] doubled

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/d813f70e6687ad6d37146ea761d2b08b20b5b664.gif[/img]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Professions[/b]: [b]Morticians[/b] now recycle gear of dead settlers if condition is above specific value.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/572d38d5e5b17bb59b72f8372b448aacde56e00e.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Tutorial:[/b] Added a new character (Arthur Sawchyn) for better immersion during the tutorial missions
[*][b]Side Missions[/b] (and new Tutorial):  Now have an Intro text
[*] [b]Side Missions[/b]: Can now be “accepted” or “declined”
[*] [b]Side Missions[/b]: Can now highlight UI elements
[*] [b]Side Missions:[/b] The timer for [b]Side Missions[/b] is now a small progress bar and the tooltip displays, how many seasons you have to fulfill the mission goals
[*] [b]Side Missions[/b]: Added typewriter effect to mission descriptions
[*][b] Side Missions[/b]: Settler talking to you won’t change anymore during a mission. During a mission, the same character will talk to you and will only change if he/she dies.
[*] [b]Side Missions[/b]: Missions can now scale in difficulty and size since they are now able to take the amount of settlers in your settlement into account.
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] Changed the Settler Badge System: Settlers are now rewarded with a [b]Badge[/b] when they reach the Age of “Old Adult”. They receive a Badge for the [b]Profession[/b] they worked the longest in. If a Settler was fully educated in a school during his childhood he will receive another Badge when he reaches the age of “Adult”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/4816cf83e34b7c3b6710bdee745e60de36a56815.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Settlers:[/b] Settler avatars now feature supersampling to avoid flickering.
[*] [b]Expeditions[/b]: Changed around some expedition goals, so the rewards make more sense
[*] [b]Expeditions[/b]: The Back-button in Story Dialogs during an Expedition now goes back to the previous Dialog instead of always going back to the Story Entry.
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Gatherer Hut now has a new ambience sound
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] Refactored UI in the  [b]Town Center[/b] for the [b]Clothing Restriction[/b].
[*] [b]Buildings:[/b] The ambient sound volume of the Expedition Station was reduced to be less dominant in the overall soundscape
[*] [b]Notifications:[/b]Improved the visuals of the tasks overview in the upper left corner.
[*] [b]Notifications:[/b] Improved displaying of notifications, some of them now stay active until clicked, so they catch your attention better.
[*] [b]Survival Handbook:[/b] Increased size of [b]Survival Handbook[/b] for better readability.
[*] [b]Game:[/b] If the player starts a new session the game is no longer paused during the intro camera animation and dialog.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ec24c6b5efe3d99ce3ed2c8ca69509be7727a983.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] The [b]Forester’s Lodge[/b] is currently a bit imbalanced. Having the option “Cut & Reforest” active does not result in trees being cut down and planted again equally. Cutting them down is much faster.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/dfcaac6be812392681ca91b0dbd7869175abdcdf.gif[/img]

The previous [b]Side Missions[/b] were very prototypical and most players didn't even notice them. Now the missions have been replaced by new and better balanced missions, which can be accepted or rejected. We've also updated the messages your settlers give you for completing or failing a mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/088939b4314dbc60423cc751eed1fb345c85fcd8.png[/img]
[i]- New mission -[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/d4ad0dec42949cb5912f1cf165e2a46665377d06.png[/img]
[i]- Completed Task -[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/6e75082c1c30cfef4e09ebecb9cbb39398b1170b.png[/img]
[i]- Failed Task -[/i]

Furthermore, two new [b]Side Missions[/b] can be unlocked by upgrading the Town Center to the third level. Through these, [b]New Settlers[/b] can occasionally be added to the settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/67662616e998a6f23b1ed55679eb59bd7f33deaa.png[/img]
[i]- New Task Window -[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/83e723ad2b81729c62f570045f7b96bcef13c1d8.gif[/img]
[i]- Radio transmission in the Town Center -[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ab7841c1f41e74217bdb7db800c85ee2fc3ead53.gif[/img]
[i]- Towncenter Tier 3 Upgrade -[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/dbb7efbc356e8625339271c6b32da9a38fa71d57.gif[/img]

The initial [b]Tutorial[/b] was short and a lot of you reported that it was also very loose and minimalistic. For this reason and with your feedback in mind we have rewritten the tutorial completely, it is now more fun and feature packed, helping newcomers to get a better grip in the game. You will learn, step by step, how to build your first settlement. In this course we have also added our first story character: "[b]Arthur Sawchyn[/b]". He’ll guide you through it, making remarks and giving helpful advice on how to expand and rebuild your settlement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/cf77df8af24d20d3a427550486ec46ae69c9c0db.gif[/img]
[i]- Arthur Sawchyn -[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/755e332a38a561a7f3d0882180566fc87e39a28d.gif[/img]
[i]- New highlighting in the Tutorial -[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/d0b5f326800857de6a7a9f198a22dadf0a7ed937.png[/img]
[i]- New Achievement -[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/297bbe692536747eab8ac1b92aa690dfbd62fab1.gif[/img]

[h2]We've updated the Roadmap and revealed another month of development![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/0004d015fb38e9d9078d25783bef933f23c648b2.jpg[/img]

[h3]We know that there are a few more things we need to address and we are listening to your feedback. We're trying to address all the important issues in a timely manner and make the game as a whole more understandable and fair. However, it is important to remember that Endzone - A World Apart is a survival game, so we have made it challenging with full intention.
[/h3]
____
[h2]On the occasion of the new Tutorial there is a stream on our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/assembleentertainment/]Twitch channel[/url] today at 6 p.m. CEST. We go through changes in Endzone together and talk about the current state of development. Join us![/h2]
____

[i]- Your Team from Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment[/i]

[b][i]- Changelog Version 0.7.7432.32175 -[/i][/b]

notes.title: Patch #003 - Early Access - Fixes & Tweaks
notes.content:
[b]Hey there survivors![/b]

We know, we just shipped a new major patch yesterday, but there were a few more things we urgently wanted to be fixed or adjusted, so your gaming experience gets even better.

The changes are mainly some "Quality of Life"-changes that were either necessary or just some feedback from our dear community, we decided to implement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/eeaf459ebeb01edf2f143de20507ffaba9b2d2a0.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]Fixed an error in the [i]TaskService[/i] when clicking “Build next” or “Repair next”.
[*]Fixed radioactive rain not irradiating the environment.
[*][b]Market[/b] no longer stocks weed as the [b]Pub[/b] needs it in its inventory.
[*]Scrap and wood can no longer be irradiated by the environment. This fixes the issue that tools, neckscarfs, etc. could be radioactive.
[*]Expeditions, from which you can find a random field/plantation seed, will no longer spawn seeds that the player already owns.
[*]Players can now try to get into the Endzone Story multiple times.
[*]Expeditions now take the right equipment with them when they are sent to loot a resource deposit.
[*]Swapping resources between the expedition and the location they are looting now works more reliable while swapping different amounts.
[*]Fixed settler badges being displayed wrong sometimes.
[*]Fixed stats not being displayed in production buildings.
[*]Unique story expeditions are now only spawned once per map.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/9b45befc9d99249c0c5d7ab04bd584eb3146e462.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]A [b]Market[/b] will no longer “steal” resources from another [b]Market[/b].
[*]Increased max. worker amount of [b]Medical Facility[/b]: [b]1 -> 3[/b]. 
[i]If you are playing from a savegame, only newly built Medical Facilities will be affected.[/i]
[*]Increased max. worker amount of [b]Workshop[/b]: [b]1 -> 2[/b]. 
[i]If you are playing from a savegame, only newly built Workshops will be affected.[/i]
[*]Changed threshold until settlers achieve a badge: [b]5 -> 4[/b] seasons
[*]Improved various tooltips for buildings and tasks.
[*]Large Scrap Piles now provide more scrap and therefore need a [b]Scrapyard[/b] to collect them.
[*]There will now always be a rainy season after a drought season
[*]There will now always be a rainy season after a no-rain season, if the upcoming season is not a drought.
[*]Remastered and improved ingame music.
[*]Settlers spawned by a story expedition now walk to the [b]Expedition Station[/b] after "Loot & Return".
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36095472/ec24c6b5efe3d99ce3ed2c8ca69509be7727a983.gif[/img]
[list]
[*]The [b]Forester Lodge[/b] and its work mode: “Cut & Reforest” is currently unbalanced. Trees are cut down faster than the time it takes to replant and regrow them.
[*]Settlers currently do not get the protection clothing with the best protection value but simply the one that is the closest.
[/list]

[h3]We know that there are a few more things we need to address and we are listening to your feedback. We're trying to address all the important issues in a timely manner and make the game as a whole more understandable and fair. However, it is important to remember that Endzone - A World Apart is a survival game, so we have made it challenging with full intention.[/h3]


- Your Team from Gentlymad & Assemble Entertainment

[b][i]- Changelog Version 0.7.7412.33364 -[/i][/b]
